<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">

    <title>Contact | Green Optima</title>

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

    <link
        href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap"
        rel="stylesheet"
    >

    <style>

        /* =========================================================
           GREEN OPTIMA — DARK PREMIUM THEME
        ========================================================= */

        :root {

            --green: #4F8F32;
            --green-light: #6FAF45;
            --green-bright: #82B95A;
            --green-dark: #18351D;

            --black: #030504;
            --black-2: #050806;
            --black-3: #080D09;
            --black-4: #0B110C;

            --cream: #EEEDE5;
            --cream-dark: #E4E2D8;

            --white: #F7F8F4;
            --white-soft: #EDEFEA;

            --text: #101510;
            --muted: #737A73;

            --dark-text: rgba(247, 248, 244, .68);

            --border-dark: rgba(111, 175, 69, .16);
            --border-light: rgba(20, 45, 24, .12);

            --radius: 24px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           RESET
        ========================================================= */

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {

            margin: 0;

            font-family:
                "DM Sans",
                sans-serif;

            background:
                var(--cream);

            color:
                var(--text);

            overflow-x: hidden;

        }

        button,
        input,
        textarea,
        select {
            font: inherit;
        }

        button {
            cursor: pointer;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           CUSTOM CURSOR
        ========================================================= */

        .cursor {

            position: fixed;

            width: 7px;
            height: 7px;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            border-radius: 50%;

            pointer-events: none;

            z-index: 9999;

            transform:
                translate(-50%, -50%);

            box-shadow:
                0 0 10px
                rgba(111,175,69,.45);

        }


        .cursor-ring {

            position: fixed;

            width: 30px;
            height: 30px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.45);

            border-radius: 50%;

            pointer-events: none;

            z-index: 9998;

            transform:
                translate(-50%, -50%);

        }


        body.cursor-active .cursor {

            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;

        }


        body.cursor-active .cursor-ring {

            width: 48px;
            height: 48px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO
        ========================================================= */

        .hero {

            position: relative;

            height: 60vh;

            min-height: 500px;

            max-height: 700px;

            overflow: hidden;

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            color:
                var(--white);

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 73% 45%,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.12),
                    transparent 32%
                ),

                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 22% 100%,
                    rgba(28,59,32,.12),
                    transparent 40%
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    135deg,
                    #030504 0%,
                    #050806 48%,
                    #0A100B 100%
                );

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO GRID
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-grid {

            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            background-image:

                linear-gradient(
                    rgba(79,143,50,.032) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.032) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                );

            background-size:
                70px 70px;

            transform:
                perspective(700px)
                rotateX(58deg)
                scale(1.5);

            transform-origin:
                center bottom;

            opacity: .7;

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO GLOW
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-glow {

            position: absolute;

            width: 650px;
            height: 650px;

            right: 0;

            top: 50%;

            transform:
                translateY(-50%);

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.10),
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035) 35%,
                    transparent 70%
                );

            filter:
                blur(18px);

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           PARTICLES
        ========================================================= */

        .particles {

            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            pointer-events: none;

        }


        .particle {

            position: absolute;

            width: 3px;
            height: 3px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            box-shadow:

                0 0 9px
                rgba(111,175,69,.6),

                0 0 22px
                rgba(79,143,50,.3);

            animation:

                floatParticle
                var(--duration)
                ease-in-out
                infinite
                alternate;

        }


        .particle:nth-child(1) {
            left: 11%;
            top: 25%;
            --duration: 4s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(2) {
            left: 28%;
            top: 70%;
            --duration: 5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(3) {
            left: 52%;
            top: 17%;
            --duration: 4.5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(4) {
            left: 71%;
            top: 27%;
            --duration: 5.5s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(5) {
            left: 89%;
            top: 57%;
            --duration: 4s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(6) {
            left: 64%;
            top: 78%;
            --duration: 6s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(7) {
            left: 43%;
            top: 35%;
            --duration: 4.7s;
        }

        .particle:nth-child(8) {
            left: 82%;
            top: 78%;
            --duration: 5.2s;
        }


        @keyframes floatParticle {

            from {

                transform:
                    translate3d(0,0,0)
                    scale(.7);

                opacity: .25;

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    translate3d(0,-24px,0)
                    scale(1.5);

                opacity: .9;

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO INNER
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-inner {

            position: relative;

            z-index: 10;

            width: 90%;

            max-width: 1450px;

            margin: auto;

            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                56% 44%;

            align-items: center;

            padding-top: 20px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO COPY
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-copy {

            position: relative;

            z-index: 20;

        }


        .eyebrow {

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            gap: 11px;

            color:
                var(--green-light);

            font-size: 11px;

            font-weight: 600;

            letter-spacing:
                .19em;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            margin-bottom: 21px;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .8s
                .15s
                forwards;

        }


        .eyebrow-line {

            width: 31px;

            height: 1px;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO TITLE
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                clamp(52px, 6.1vw, 94px);

            line-height:
                .88;

            letter-spacing:
                -.065em;

            font-weight:
                600;

            max-width:
                780px;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .9s
                .3s
                forwards;

        }


        .hero-title .white {

            color:
                var(--white);

        }


        .hero-title .green {

            color:
                var(--green-light);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO DESCRIPTION
        ========================================================= */

        .hero-description {

            max-width:
                530px;

            margin-top:
                25px;

            color:
                rgba(247,248,244,.58);

            font-size:
                15px;

            line-height:
                1.65;

            opacity: 0;

            animation:
                revealUp
                .8s
                .5s
                forwards;

        }


        @keyframes revealUp {

            from {

                opacity: 0;

                transform:
                    translateY(24px);

            }

            to {

                opacity: 1;

                transform:
                    translateY(0);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           3D VISUAL AREA
        ========================================================= */

        .visual-area {

            height:
                400px;

            position:
                relative;

            perspective:
                1000px;

            display:
                flex;

            align-items:
                center;

            justify-content:
                center;

            animation:
                visualEnter
                1.2s
                .2s
                both;

        }


        @keyframes visualEnter {

            from {

                opacity: 0;

                transform:
                    scale(.82)
                    translateX(35px);

            }

            to {

                opacity: 1;

                transform:
                    scale(1)
                    translateX(0);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           3D SYSTEM
        ========================================================= */

        .system {

            width:
                365px;

            height:
                365px;

            position:
                relative;

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            transform:
                rotateX(57deg)
                rotateZ(-28deg);

            animation:
                systemFloat
                8s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        @keyframes systemFloat {

            0%,
            100% {

                transform:
                    rotateX(57deg)
                    rotateZ(-28deg)
                    translateY(0);

            }

            50% {

                transform:
                    rotateX(57deg)
                    rotateZ(-28deg)
                    translateY(-17px);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           BUILDING
        ========================================================= */

        .building {

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                145px;

            height:
                205px;

            left:
                110px;

            top:
                80px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.42);

            background:

                linear-gradient(
                    135deg,
                    rgba(255,255,255,.025),
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035)
                );

            box-shadow:

                inset 0 0 45px
                rgba(79,143,50,.04),

                0 0 40px
                rgba(79,143,50,.06);

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            animation:
                buildingPulse
                5s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        .building::before {

            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 18px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.23);

        }


        .building::after {

            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 36px;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.14);

        }


        @keyframes buildingPulse {

            0%,
            100% {

                box-shadow:

                    inset 0 0 45px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.025),

                    0 0 30px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.035);

            }

            50% {

                box-shadow:

                    inset 0 0 55px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.065),

                    0 0 55px
                    rgba(79,143,50,.075);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           BUILDING WINDOWS
        ========================================================= */

        .windows {

            position:
                absolute;

            inset:
                45px 30px;

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(4,1fr);

            grid-template-rows:
                repeat(5,1fr);

            gap:
                10px;

        }


        .window {

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.13);

            background:
                rgba(79,143,50,.025);

            animation:
                windowGlow
                3.2s
                ease-in-out
                infinite
                alternate;

        }


        .window:nth-child(2n) {
            animation-delay: .7s;
        }

        .window:nth-child(3n) {
            animation-delay: 1.2s;
        }


        @keyframes windowGlow {

            from {

                background:
                    rgba(79,143,50,.018);

            }

            to {

                background:
                    rgba(79,143,50,.075);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           ORBITS
        ========================================================= */

        .orbit {

            position:
                absolute;

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.24);

            border-radius:
                50%;

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

        }


        .orbit.one {

            width:
                410px;

            height:
                145px;

            left:
                -22px;

            top:
                110px;

            animation:
                orbitOne
                10s
                linear
                infinite;

        }


        .orbit.two {

            width:
                300px;

            height:
                110px;

            left:
                35px;

            top:
                128px;

            opacity:
                .65;

            animation:
                orbitTwo
                8s
                linear
                infinite
                reverse;

        }


        .orbit.three {

            width:
                250px;

            height:
                90px;

            left:
                62px;

            top:
                142px;

            opacity:
                .35;

            animation:
                orbitThree
                7s
                linear
                infinite;

        }


        @keyframes orbitOne {

            from {
                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg);
            }

            to {
                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg);
            }

        }


        @keyframes orbitTwo {

            from {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg)
                    rotateX(10deg);

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg)
                    rotateX(10deg);

            }

        }


        @keyframes orbitThree {

            from {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(0deg)
                    rotateY(20deg);

            }

            to {

                transform:
                    rotateZ(360deg)
                    rotateY(20deg);

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           NODES
        ========================================================= */

        .node {

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                9px;

            height:
                9px;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            background:
                var(--green-light);

            box-shadow:

                0 0 10px
                rgba(111,175,69,.65),

                0 0 30px
                rgba(79,143,50,.35);

            z-index:
                5;

            animation:
                nodePulse
                2.7s
                ease-in-out
                infinite;

        }


        .node.one {

            left:
                20px;

            top:
                80px;

        }


        .node.two {

            right:
                15px;

            top:
                125px;

            animation-delay:
                .6s;

        }


        .node.three {

            left:
                60px;

            bottom:
                65px;

            animation-delay:
                1s;

        }


        .node.four {

            right:
                65px;

            bottom:
                45px;

            animation-delay:
                1.5s;

        }


        @keyframes nodePulse {

            0%,
            100% {

                transform:
                    scale(.8);

                opacity:
                    .45;

            }

            50% {

                transform:
                    scale(1.6);

                opacity:
                    1;

            }

        }


        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT SECTION
        ========================================================= */

        .contact-section {

            position:
                relative;

            background:
                var(--cream);

            padding:
                105px 5vw 110px;

        }


        .section-container {

            width:
                90%;

            max-width:
                1400px;

            margin:
                auto;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           SECTION HEADER
        ========================================================= */

        .section-header {

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                .3fr 1fr;

            gap:
                50px;

            align-items:
                start;

            margin-bottom:
                65px;

        }


        .section-label {

            color:
                var(--green-dark);

            font-size:
                11px;

            font-weight:
                700;

            letter-spacing:
                .18em;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            padding-top:
                10px;

        }


        .section-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                clamp(45px,5vw,76px);

            line-height:
                .94;

            letter-spacing:
                -.055em;

            font-weight:
                600;

        }


        .section-title span {

            color:
                var(--green);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT GRID
        ========================================================= */

        .contact-grid {

            display:
                grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                .75fr 1.25fr;

            gap:
                25px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           INFORMATION CARD
        ========================================================= */

        .info-card {

            position:
                relative;

            overflow:
                hidden;

            min-height:
                520px;

            padding:
                42px;

            border-radius:
                var(--radius);

            color:
                var(--white);

            background:

                linear-gradient(
                    145deg,
                    #0B110D,
                    #050806
                );

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.10);

            box-shadow:
                0 25px 70px
                rgba(0,0,0,.16);

            transform-style:
                preserve-3d;

            transition:
                transform .25s ease;

        }


        .info-card::before {

            content: "";

            position:
                absolute;

            width:
                450px;

            height:
                450px;

            right:
                -260px;

            bottom:
                -250px;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            background:

                radial-gradient(
                    circle,
                    rgba(79,143,50,.16),
                    transparent 65%
                );

        }


        .info-card-grid {

            position:
                absolute;

            inset:
                0;

            background-image:

                linear-gradient(
                    rgba(111,175,69,.025) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                ),

                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(111,175,69,.025) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                );

            background-size:
                45px 45px;

            mask-image:
                linear-gradient(
                    to bottom right,
                    black,
                    transparent
                );

        }


        .info-content {

            position:
                relative;

            z-index:
                2;

        }


        .info-title {

            font-family:
                "Space Grotesk",
                sans-serif;

            font-size:
                36px;

            letter-spacing:
                -.04em;

            margin-bottom:
                16px;

        }


        .info-description {

            color:
                rgba(247,248,244,.54);

            line-height:
                1.7;

            font-size:
                15px;

            margin-bottom:
                35px;

            max-width:
                420px;

        }


        /* =========================================================
           INFORMATION ITEMS
        ========================================================= */

        .info-item {

            display:
                flex;

            gap:
                15px;

            padding:
                18px 0;

            border-bottom:
                1px solid
                rgba(255,255,255,.07);

        }


        .info-icon {

            width:
                42px;

            height:
                42px;

            flex-shrink:
                0;

            border-radius:
                50%;

            display:
                flex;

            align-items:
                center;

            justify-content:
                center;

            background:
                rgba(79,143,50,.09);

            border:
                1px solid
                rgba(111,175,69,.20);

            color:
                var(--green-light);

            font-size:
                15px;

        }


        .info-item small {

            display:
                block;

            color:
                rgba(255,255,255,.35);

            font-size:
                10px;

            text-transform:
                uppercase;

            letter-spacing:
                .13em;

            margin-bottom:
                5px;

        }


        .info-item strong {

            font-size:
                14px;

            font-weight:
                500;

            color:
                rgba(255,255,255,.86);

        }


        /* =========================================================
           FORM CARD
        ========================================================= */

        .form-card {

            background:
                #FFFFFF;

            border-radius:
                var(--radius);

            padding:
                42px;

            border:
                1px solid

        /* =========================================================

        @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {

    </style>
</head>

    <script>

        /* =========================================================
           CUSTOM CURSOR
        ========================================================= */

        const cursor =
            document.querySelector(".cursor");

        const cursorRing =
            document.querySelector(".cursor-ring");


        document.addEventListener(
            "mousemove",
            function(event) {

                cursor.style.left =
                    event.clientX + "px";

                cursor.style.top =
                    event.clientY + "px";


                cursorRing.animate(

                    {
                        left:
                            event.clientX + "px",

                        top:
                            event.clientY + "px"
                    },

                    {
                        duration: 300,

                        fill: "forwards"
                    }

                );

            }
        );


        document
            .querySelectorAll(
                "button, input, textarea, select"
            )
            .forEach(
                function(element) {

                    element.addEventListener(
                        "mouseenter",
                        function() {

                            document.body.classList.add(
                                "cursor-active"
                            );

                        }
                    );


                    element.addEventListener(
                        "mouseleave",
                        function() {

                            document.body.classList.remove(
                                "cursor-active"
                            );

                        }
                    );

                }
            );



        /* =========================================================
           3D MOUSE PARALLAX
        ========================================================= */

        const system =
            document.querySelector(".system");


        document.addEventListener(
            "mousemove",
            function(event) {

                if (
                    window.innerWidth < 900
                ) {
                    return;
                }


                const x =
                    event.clientX /
                    window.innerWidth - .5;


                const y =
                    event.clientY /
                    window.innerHeight - .5;


                system.style.transform =

                    `
                    rotateX(${57 + y * 5}deg)
                    rotateZ(${-28 + x * 7}deg)
                    translateY(${y * -10}px)
                    `;

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           CARD TILT
        ========================================================= */

        const cards =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".info-card, .form-card"
            );


        cards.forEach(
            function(card) {


                card.addEventListener(
                    "mousemove",
                    function(event) {

                        if (
                            window.innerWidth < 900
                        ) {
                            return;
                        }


                        const rect =
                            card.getBoundingClientRect();


                        const x =
                            event.clientX -
                            rect.left;


                        const y =
                            event.clientY -
                            rect.top;


                        const rotateY =
                            ((x / rect.width) - .5)
                            * 3;


                        const rotateX =
                            ((y / rect.height) - .5)
                            * -3;


                        card.style.transform =

                            `
                            perspective(1200px)
                            rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
                            rotateY(${rotateY}deg)
                            translateY(-2px)
                            `;

                    }
                );


                card.addEventListener(
                    "mouseleave",
                    function() {

                        card.style.transform =
                            "perspective(1200px) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)";

                    }
                );

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           SCROLL REVEAL
        ========================================================= */

        const revealElements =
            document.querySelectorAll(
                ".reveal"
            );


        const observer =
            new IntersectionObserver(

                function(entries) {

                    entries.forEach(
                        function(entry) {

                            if (
                                entry.isIntersecting
                            ) {

                                entry.target.classList.add(
                                    "visible"
                                );

                                observer.unobserve(
                                    entry.target
                                );

                            }

                        }
                    );

                },

                {
                    threshold: .12
                }

            );


        revealElements.forEach(
            function(element) {

                observer.observe(element);

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           CONTACT FORM
        ========================================================= */

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "contactForm"
            );


        const success =
            document.getElementById(
                "successMessage"
            );


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function(event) {

                event.preventDefault();


                const buttonText =
                    form.querySelector(
                        ".submit-btn span"
                    );


                buttonText.textContent =
                    "SENDING...";


                setTimeout(
                    function() {

                        buttonText.textContent =
                            "ENQUIRY SENT ✓";


                        success.classList.add(
                            "show"
                        );


                        form.reset();


                        setTimeout(
                            function() {

                                success.classList.remove(
                                    "show"
                                );


                                buttonText.textContent =
                                    "SEND ENQUIRY →";

                            },
                            3500
                        );

                    },
                    900
                );

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           SUBTLE HERO MOUSE MOVEMENT
        ========================================================= */

        const hero =
            document.querySelector(".hero");

        const heroGlow =
            document.querySelector(".hero-glow");


        document.addEventListener(
            "mousemove",
            function(event) {

                if (
                    window.innerWidth < 900
                ) {
                    return;
                }


                const x =
                    (event.clientX /
                    window.innerWidth - .5) * 20;


                const y =
                    (event.clientY /
                    window.innerHeight - .5) * 20;


                heroGlow.style.transform =
                    `
                    translate(
                        ${x}px,
                        calc(-50% + ${y}px)
                    )
                    `;

            }
        );



        /* =========================================================
           ESCAPE — RESET
        ========================================================= */

        window.addEventListener(
            "resize",
            function() {

                if (
                    window.innerWidth < 900
                ) {

                    system.style.transform =
                        "rotateX(57deg) rotateZ(-28deg)";

                }

            }
        );

    </script>

</body>
</html>

        content="Green Optima — Smart building automation, IoT, energy management, metering, lighting control and intelligent infrastructure solutions."
    >

    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
    <link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>

    <link
        href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700;800&display=swap"
        rel="stylesheet"
    >

    <style>

        /* =========================================================
           RESET
        ========================================================= */

        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
        }

        html {
            scroll-behavior: smooth;
        }

        body {
            font-family: "DM Sans", sans-serif;
            background: #050805;
            color: #ffffff;
            overflow-x: hidden;
        }

        a {
            color: inherit;
            text-decoration: none;
        }

        button {
            font: inherit;
        }

        ::selection {
            background: #8cff00;
            color: #071006;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           VARIABLES
        ========================================================= */

        :root {
            --green: #8cff00;
            --green-dark: #4c8f00;
            --green-soft: #b8ff70;

            --black: #050805;
            --black-2: #080d08;
            --black-3: #0c120d;

            --white: #ffffff;
            --muted: rgba(255,255,255,0.62);
            --line: rgba(255,255,255,0.11);

            --radius: 26px;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           GLOBAL
        ========================================================= */

        .page {
            width: 100%;
            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .container {
            width: min(1240px, calc(100% - 48px));
            margin: auto;
        }

        .eyebrow {
            display: inline-flex;
            align-items: center;
            gap: 10px;

            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: 700;
            letter-spacing: 0.18em;
            text-transform: uppercase;

            color: var(--green);
        }

        .eyebrow::before {
            content: "";
            width: 28px;
            height: 1px;
            background: var(--green);
        }

        .section-title {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;
            font-size: clamp(42px, 6vw, 82px);
            line-height: 0.95;
            letter-spacing: -0.055em;
            font-weight: 700;
        }

        .section-title span {
            color: var(--green);
        }

        .section-description {
            max-width: 600px;
            margin-top: 24px;

            font-size: 16px;
            line-height: 1.7;
            color: var(--muted);
        }


        /* =========================================================
           CUSTOM CURSOR
        ========================================================= */

        .cursor {
            position: fixed;

            width: 10px;
            height: 10px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background: var(--green);

            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9999;

            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

            box-shadow:
                0 0 15px rgba(140,255,0,0.8),
                0 0 35px rgba(140,255,0,0.35);

            transition:
                width 0.2s ease,
                height 0.2s ease;
        }

        .cursor-ring {
            position: fixed;

            width: 34px;
            height: 34px;

            border: 1px solid rgba(140,255,0,0.6);

            border-radius: 50%;

            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 9998;

            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);

            transition:
                width 0.2s ease,
                height 0.2s ease;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           HERO
        ========================================================= */

        .hero {
            position: relative;

            min-height: 100vh;

            display: flex;
            align-items: center;

            overflow: hidden;

            background: #061006;
        }

        .hero-video {
            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;

            object-fit: cover;

            filter:
                brightness(0.82)
                contrast(1.05)
                saturate(1.12);

            transform: scale(1.04);

            z-index: 0;
        }

        .hero-overlay {
            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            background:
                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(3,8,4,0.82) 0%,
                    rgba(3,8,4,0.52) 42%,
                    rgba(3,8,4,0.16) 100%
                );

            z-index: 1;
        }

        .hero-green-glow {
            position: absolute;

            width: 650px;
            height: 650px;

            left: -250px;
            top: 5%;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background: rgba(101,255,0,0.12);

            filter: blur(120px);

            z-index: 1;
        }

        .hero-grid {
            position: absolute;

            inset: 0;

            background-image:
                linear-gradient(
                    rgba(255,255,255,0.035) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                ),
                linear-gradient(
                    90deg,
                    rgba(255,255,255,0.035) 1px,
                    transparent 1px
                );

            background-size: 80px 80px;

            mask-image: linear-gradient(
                to bottom,
                rgba(0,0,0,0.7),
                transparent 90%
            );

            opacity: 0.3;

            z-index: 2;
        }

        .hero-content {
            position: relative;

            z-index: 3;

            padding: 140px 0 100px;
        }

        .hero-brand {
            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;

            letter-spacing: 0.3em;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.82);

            margin-bottom: 38px;
        }

        .hero-title {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            max-width: 850px;

            font-size: clamp(56px, 8vw, 118px);

            line-height: 0.9;

            letter-spacing: -0.065em;

            font-weight: 800;
        }

        .hero-title .green {
            color: var(--green);
        }

        .hero-subtitle {
            max-width: 570px;

            margin-top: 34px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.72);

            font-size: 18px;

            line-height: 1.7;
        }

        .hero-actions {
            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            gap: 16px;

            margin-top: 38px;
        }

        .btn {
            display: inline-flex;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            gap: 12px;

            padding: 15px 22px;

            border-radius: 999px;

            font-size: 13px;
            font-weight: 700;

            transition:
                transform 0.3s ease,
                background 0.3s ease,
                color 0.3s ease,
                border-color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .btn-primary {
            background: var(--green);

            color: #071006;

            box-shadow:
                0 0 0 rgba(140,255,0,0);
        }

        .btn-primary:hover {
            transform: translateY(-3px);

            box-shadow:
                0 12px 35px rgba(140,255,0,0.22);
        }

        .btn-outline {
            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.22);

            background: rgba(0,0,0,0.18);

            color: white;

            backdrop-filter: blur(10px);
        }

        .btn-outline:hover {
            border-color: var(--green);

            color: var(--green);

            transform: translateY(-3px);
        }

        .hero-bottom {
            position: absolute;

            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            bottom: 34px;

            z-index: 4;
        }

        .hero-scroll {
            display: flex;

            align-items: center;

            gap: 12px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.6);

            font-size: 11px;

            letter-spacing: 0.14em;

            text-transform: uppercase;
        }

        .scroll-line {
            width: 45px;
            height: 1px;

            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.35);
        }


        /* =========================================================
           INTRO
        ========================================================= */

        .intro {
            position: relative;

            padding: 150px 0 120px;

            background:
                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 90% 20%,
                    rgba(140,255,0,0.08),
                    transparent 28%
                ),
                var(--black);
        }

        .intro-layout {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns: 1fr 0.75fr;

            gap: 100px;

            align-items: end;
        }

        .intro-number {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 160px;

            line-height: 0.7;

            font-weight: 800;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.035);

            margin-bottom: 35px;
        }

        .intro-right {
            padding-bottom: 5px;
        }

        .intro-right p {
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.65);

            line-height: 1.8;

            font-size: 16px;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           SERVICES
        ========================================================= */

        .services {
            padding: 110px 0 140px;

            background: #080d08;
        }

        .section-heading-row {
            display: flex;

            justify-content: space-between;

            align-items: end;

            gap: 40px;

            margin-bottom: 70px;
        }

        .service-count {
            font-size: 13px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.4);

            letter-spacing: 0.08em;
        }

        .services-grid {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(3, 1fr);

            gap: 16px;
        }

        .service-card {
            position: relative;

            min-height: 310px;

            padding: 30px;

            border: 1px solid var(--line);

            border-radius: var(--radius);

            background:
                linear-gradient(
                    145deg,
                    rgba(255,255,255,0.055),
                    rgba(255,255,255,0.015)
                );

            overflow: hidden;

            transition:
                transform 0.4s ease,
                border-color 0.4s ease,
                background 0.4s ease;
        }

        .service-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-8px);

            border-color: rgba(140,255,0,0.4);

            background:
                linear-gradient(
                    145deg,
                    rgba(140,255,0,0.08),
                    rgba(255,255,255,0.02)
                );
        }

        .service-card::after {
            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            width: 170px;
            height: 170px;

            right: -80px;
            bottom: -80px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            background: rgba(140,255,0,0.12);

            filter: blur(30px);

            opacity: 0;

            transition: opacity 0.4s ease;
        }

        .service-card:hover::after {
            opacity: 1;
        }

        .service-number {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 13px;

            color: var(--green);

            margin-bottom: 70px;
        }

        .service-card h3 {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 25px;

            line-height: 1.1;

            letter-spacing: -0.035em;
        }

        .service-card p {
            margin-top: 13px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.52);

            font-size: 14px;

            line-height: 1.6;

            max-width: 310px;
        }

        .service-arrow {
            position: absolute;

            right: 28px;
            bottom: 27px;

            width: 42px;
            height: 42px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.16);

            color: var(--green);

            transition:
                background 0.3s ease,
                transform 0.3s ease;
        }

        .service-card:hover .service-arrow {
            background: var(--green);

            color: #071006;

            transform: rotate(-45deg);
        }


        /* =========================================================
           SUB SERVICES
        ========================================================= */

        .subservices {
            padding: 120px 0;

            background: var(--black);
        }

        .subservice-list {
            margin-top: 70px;

            border-top: 1px solid var(--line);
        }

        .subservice-row {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns: 70px 1fr 1.2fr 50px;

            gap: 30px;

            align-items: center;

            padding: 30px 10px;

            border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);

            transition:
                background 0.3s ease,
                padding 0.3s ease;
        }

        .subservice-row:hover {
            background: rgba(140,255,0,0.035);

            padding-left: 20px;
            padding-right: 20px;
        }

        .sub-number {
            color: var(--green);

            font-size: 12px;

            letter-spacing: 0.1em;
        }

        .subservice-row h3 {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 22px;

            letter-spacing: -0.025em;
        }

        .subservice-row p {
            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48);

            font-size: 14px;

            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .sub-link {
            width: 40px;
            height: 40px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.17);

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            color: var(--green);

            transition:
                background 0.3s ease,
                color 0.3s ease;
        }

        .subservice-row:hover .sub-link {
            background: var(--green);

            color: #071006;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           PRODUCTS
        ========================================================= */

        .products {
            padding: 130px 0;

            background:
                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 15% 30%,
                    rgba(140,255,0,0.06),
                    transparent 30%
                ),
                #080d08;
        }

        .products-grid {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(3, 1fr);

            gap: 16px;

            margin-top: 70px;
        }

        .product-card {
            position: relative;

            min-height: 270px;

            padding: 28px;

            border: 1px solid var(--line);

            border-radius: var(--radius);

            background: #0a100a;

            overflow: hidden;

            transition:
                transform 0.4s ease,
                border-color 0.4s ease;
        }

        .product-card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-7px);

            border-color: rgba(140,255,0,0.42);
        }

        .product-card::before {
            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            width: 240px;
            height: 240px;

            right: -130px;
            top: -130px;

            border-radius: 50%;

            border: 1px solid rgba(140,255,0,0.08);

            box-shadow:
                0 0 0 35px rgba(140,255,0,0.025),
                0 0 0 70px rgba(140,255,0,0.015);
        }

        .product-logo {
            width: 50px;
            height: 50px;

            display: flex;

            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;

            border-radius: 15px;

            background: rgba(140,255,0,0.08);

            border: 1px solid rgba(140,255,0,0.14);

            color: var(--green);

            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-weight: 800;

            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .product-card h3 {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 25px;

            margin-top: 45px;

            letter-spacing: -0.04em;
        }

        .product-card p {
            margin-top: 12px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.48);

            font-size: 14px;

            line-height: 1.6;
        }

        .product-button {
            display: inline-flex;

            align-items: center;

            gap: 8px;

            margin-top: 22px;

            color: var(--green);

            font-size: 12px;

            font-weight: 700;

            letter-spacing: 0.05em;

            text-transform: uppercase;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           PRODUCT DETAILS
        ========================================================= */

        .product-details {
            background: var(--black);
        }

        .product-detail {
            min-height: 620px;

            padding: 130px 0;

            border-top: 1px solid var(--line);

            scroll-margin-top: 20px;
        }

        .detail-layout {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns: 0.75fr 1.25fr;

            gap: 100px;

            align-items: center;
        }

        .detail-index {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: 150px;

            font-weight: 800;

            line-height: 0.7;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.035);
        }

        .detail-content h2 {
            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: clamp(45px, 6vw, 80px);

            letter-spacing: -0.055em;

            line-height: 0.95;
        }

        .detail-content h2 span {
            color: var(--green);
        }

        .detail-content > p {
            max-width: 650px;

            margin-top: 25px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58);

            line-height: 1.8;

            font-size: 15px;
        }

        .feature-grid {
            display: grid;

            grid-template-columns:
                repeat(2, 1fr);

            gap: 10px;

            margin-top: 35px;

            max-width: 650px;
        }

        .feature {
            padding: 17px 18px;

            border-radius: 14px;

            border: 1px solid var(--line);

            background: rgba(255,255,255,0.025);

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.7);

            font-size: 13px;
        }

        .feature::before {
            content: "＋";

            color: var(--green);

            margin-right: 8px;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           CTA
        ========================================================= */

        .cta {
            position: relative;

            padding: 150px 0;

            background:
                radial-gradient(
                    circle at 50% 0%,
                    rgba(140,255,0,0.14),
                    transparent 45%
                ),
                #071007;

            text-align: center;

            overflow: hidden;
        }

        .cta::before {
            content: "";

            position: absolute;

            inset: 30px;

            border: 1px solid rgba(140,255,0,0.08);

            border-radius: 40px;

            pointer-events: none;
        }

        .cta h2 {
            position: relative;

            font-family: "Manrope", sans-serif;

            font-size: clamp(48px, 7vw, 100px);

            line-height: 0.9;

            letter-spacing: -0.06em;
        }

        .cta h2 span {
            color: var(--green);
        }

        .cta p {
            position: relative;

            max-width: 580px;

            margin: 28px auto 35px;

            color: rgba(255,255,255,0.58);

            line-height: 1.7;
        }


        /* =========================================================
           SCROLL REVEAL
        ========================================================= */

        .reveal {
            opacity: 0;

            transform: translateY(35px);

            transition:
                opacity 0.8s ease,
                transform 0.8s ease;
        }

        .reveal.active {
            opacity: 1;

            transform: translateY(0);
        }


        /* =========================================================
           RESPONSIVE
        ========================================================= */

        @media (max-width: 1000px) {

            .services-grid,
            .products-grid {
                grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            }

            .intro-layout,
            .detail-layout {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;

                gap: 45px;
            }

            .detail-index {
                font-size: 100px;
            }

            .subservice-row {
                grid-template-columns:
                    55px 1fr 50px;
            }

            .subservice-row p {
                display: none;
            }

        }


        @media (max-width: 700px) {

            .container {
                width: min(100% - 30px, 1240px);
            }

            .cursor,
            .cursor-ring {
                display: none;
            }

            .hero {
                min-height: 92vh;
            }

            .hero-content {
                padding: 120px 0 80px;
            }

            .hero-title {
                font-size: clamp(52px, 15vw, 85px);
            }

            .hero-subtitle {
                font-size: 15px;
            }

            .hero-actions {
                flex-wrap: wrap;
            }

            .intro {
                padding: 90px 0;
            }

            .intro-number {
                font-size: 100px;
            }

            .services,
            .subservices,
            .products {
                padding: 90px 0;
            }

            .section-heading-row {
                display: block;
            }

            .service-count {
                display: block;

                margin-top: 20px;
            }

            .services-grid,
            .products-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;

                margin-top: 45px;
            }

            .service-card {
                min-height: 280px;
            }

            .subservice-list {
                margin-top: 45px;
            }

            .subservice-row {
                grid-template-columns:
                    45px 1fr 40px;

                gap: 14px;

                padding: 24px 4px;
            }

            .subservice-row h3 {
                font-size: 17px;
            }

            .product-detail {
                padding: 90px 0;
            }

            .detail-layout {
                gap: 30px;
            }

            .detail-index {
                font-size: 80px;
            }

            .feature-grid {
                grid-template-columns: 1fr;
            }

            .cta {
                padding: 110px 0;
            }

            .cta::before {
                inset: 15px;
            }

        }

    </style>
</head>


<body>

<div class="page">

    <!-- =========================================================
         HERO
    ========================================================== -->

    <section class="hero" id="top">

        <!--
            IMPORTANT:
            Replace the src below with the direct MP4 URL of the
            Pixabay Dubai video:

            https://pixabay.com/videos/city-cityscape-buildings-dubai-264535/

            The selected Pixabay video is the Dubai cityscape video.
        -->

        <video
            class="hero-video"
            id="heroVideo"
            autoplay
            muted
            loop
            playsinline
            preload="auto"
        >
            <!-- DIRECT PIXABAY MP4 URL GOES HERE -->
            <source
                id="heroVideoSource"
                src=""
                type="video/mp4"
            >
        </video>

        <div class="hero-overlay"></div>

        <div class="hero-green-glow"></div>

        <div class="hero-grid"></div>


        <div class="container">

            <div class="hero-content">

                <div class="hero-brand">
                    GREEN OPTIMA
                </div>

                <div class="eyebrow">
                    SMART INTEGRATOR
                </div>

                <h1 class="hero-title">
                    Intelligent
                    <span class="green">spaces.</span>
                    Connected
                    <span class="green">future.</span>
                </h1>

                <p class="hero-subtitle">
                    Smart building automation, IoT, energy intelligence
                    and connected infrastructure designed to make
                    buildings perform better.
                </p>

                <div class="hero-actions">

                    <a
                        href="#services"
                        class="btn btn-primary"
                    >
                        Explore Solutions
                        <span>↘</span>
                    </a>

                    <a
                        href="#products"
                        class="btn btn-outline"
                    >
                        Explore Products
                        <span>↓</span>
                    </a>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>


        <div class="hero-bottom">

            <div class="container">

                <div class="hero-scroll">
                    <span class="scroll-line"></span>
                    Scroll to explore
                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </section>



    <!-- =========================================================
         INTRO
    ========================================================== -->

    <section class="intro">

        <div class="container">

            <div class="intro-layout">

                <div class="reveal">

                    <div class="intro-number">
                        01
                    </div>

                    <div class="eyebrow">
                        GREEN OPTIMA
                    </div>

                    <h2 class="section-title">
                        Building
                        <span>intelligence</span>
                        into every layer.
                    </h2>

                </div>


                <div class="intro-right reveal">

                    <p>
                        Green Optima brings together building management,
                        IoT, energy monitoring, intelligent lighting,
                        access control and connected infrastructure
                        into integrated solutions for modern buildings.
                    </p>

                    <br>

                    <p>
                        From field devices and controllers to dashboards
                        and enterprise-level systems, our solutions
                        connect the physical building with actionable
                        operational intelligence.
                    </p>

                </div>

            </div>

        </div>

    </section>



    <!-- =========================================================
         SERVICES
    ========================================================== -->

    <section
        class="services"
        id="services"
    >

        <div class="container">

    const PIXABAY_VIDEO_URL = "";


    const heroVideo = document.getElementById("heroVideo");
    const heroVideoSource = document.getElementById("heroVideoSource");


    if (PIXABAY_VIDEO_URL.trim() !== "") {

        heroVideoSource.src = PIXABAY_VIDEO_URL;

        heroVideo.load();

        heroVideo.play().catch(() => {});

    }


    /* =========================================================
       SMOOTH ANCHOR SCROLL
    ========================================================== */

    document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(link => {

        link.addEventListener("click", function(event) {

            const targetId = this.getAttribute("href");

            if (!targetId || targetId === "#") {
                return;
            }

            const target = document.querySelector(targetId);

            if (!target) {
                return;
            }

            event.preventDefault();

            target.scrollIntoView({
                behavior: "smooth",
                block: "start"
            });

        });

    });


    /* =========================================================
       SCROLL REVEAL
    ========================================================== */

    const revealElements =
        document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");


    const revealObserver =
        new IntersectionObserver(

            entries => {

                entries.forEach(entry => {

                    if (entry.isIntersecting) {

                        entry.target.classList.add("active");

                        revealObserver.unobserve(entry.target);

                    }

                });

            },

            {
                threshold: 0.12
            }

        );


    revealElements.forEach(element => {

        revealObserver.observe(element);

    });


    /* =========================================================
       HERO VIDEO PARALLAX
    ========================================================== */

    window.addEventListener(
        "scroll",
        () => {

            if (!heroVideo) {
                return;
            }

            const scroll =
                window.scrollY;

            if (scroll < window.innerHeight) {

                heroVideo.style.transform =
                    `scale(1.04) translateY(${scroll * 0.08}px)`;

            }

        },
        {
            passive: true
        }
    );


    /* =========================================================
       CUSTOM CURSOR
    ========================================================== */

    const cursor =
        document.createElement("div");

    cursor.className = "cursor";

    const cursorRing =
        document.createElement("div");

    cursorRing.className = "cursor-ring";

    document.body.appendChild(cursor);
    document.body.appendChild(cursorRing);


    let mouseX = 0;
    let mouseY = 0;

    let ringX = 0;
    let ringY = 0;


    document.addEventListener(
        "mousemove",
        event => {

            mouseX = event.clientX;
            mouseY = event.clientY;

            cursor.style.left =
                mouseX + "px";

            cursor.style.top =
                mouseY + "px";

        }
    );


    function animateCursor() {

        ringX +=
            (mouseX - ringX) * 0.15;

        ringY +=
            (mouseY - ringY) * 0.15;

        cursorRing.style.left =
            ringX + "px";

        cursorRing.style.top =
            ringY + "px";

        requestAnimationFrame(
            animateCursor
        );

    }


    animateCursor();


    /* =========================================================
       CURSOR HOVER
    ========================================================== */

    document.querySelectorAll(
        "a, button"
    ).forEach(element => {

        element.addEventListener(
            "mouseenter",
            () => {

                cursor.style.width = "18px";
                cursor.style.height = "18px";

                cursorRing.style.width = "48px";
                cursorRing.style.height = "48px";

            }
        );


        element.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            () => {

                cursor.style.width = "10px";
                cursor.style.height = "10px";

                cursorRing.style.width = "34px";
                cursorRing.style.height = "34px";

            }
        );

    });


    /* =========================================================
       MOBILE CURSOR
    ========================================================== */

    if (
        window.matchMedia(
            "(pointer: coarse)"
        ).matches
    ) {

        cursor.remove();
        cursorRing.remove();

    }

</script>

</body>
</html>

/* =========================================================

/* =========================================================
   3. TYPOGRAPHY + SHARED UI

.wrap{width:min(1380px,calc(100% - 2*var(--gutter)));margin-inline:auto}

.btn:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(167,232,91,.18),0 18px 50px -10px rgba(124,203,53,.7);background:var(--white)}
.btn .arr{display:inline-block;transition:transform .45s var(--ease)}
.btn:hover .arr{transform:translateX(7px)}
.arr{width:1.1em;height:1.1em;flex:none}

.rv{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,46px,0);filter:blur(10px);transition:opacity 1.1s var(--ease),transform 1.2s var(--ease),filter 1.1s var(--ease);transition-delay:var(--d,0s)}
.rv[data-rv=scale]{transform:scale(.86)}
.rv[data-rv=left]{transform:translate3d(-60px,0,0)}

/* =========================================================
   4. HERO
   ========================================================= */
.hero{position:relative;min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;overflow:hidden;background:var(--black);isolation:isolate;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:clamp(60px,10vh,110px) var(--gutter) clamp(90px,14vh,140px)}

/* =========================================================

.hero-scene{position:absolute;z-index:2;left:70%;top:48%;width:0;height:0;perspective:1700px;transform:translate3d(var(--px,0px),var(--py,0px),0) scale(var(--sc,1));pointer-events:none}

.rwrap{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;transform-style:preserve-3d;transform:rotateX(75deg) scale(.2);opacity:0;transition:transform 2.2s var(--ease),opacity 1.4s ease;transition-delay:var(--rd,.7s)}

.beam{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:1px;transform-origin:0 50%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(124,203,53,.05),rgba(124,203,53,.5),rgba(124,203,53,.05));opacity:0;transition:opacity 1.4s ease 2.6s}

.tlabel{position:absolute;left:0;top:0;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;white-space:nowrap;font-family:var(--display);font-size:.62rem;letter-spacing:.24em;color:var(--cream);opacity:0;transition:opacity 1s ease,transform 1.2s var(--ease);transition-delay:calc(3s + var(--i)*.14s);transform:translate3d(var(--lx),var(--ly),0) translateX(-24px)}
.is-ready .tlabel{opacity:.9;transform:translate3d(var(--lx),var(--ly),0)}
.tlabel::before{content:"";width:46px;height:1px;background:var(--bright-green)}

/* =========================================================
   INTRO / TRANSITION SECTION
   ========================================================= */
.intro{position:relative;z-index:3;margin-top:calc(-1 * clamp(20px,3vw,44px));border-radius:clamp(28px,5vw,80px) clamp(28px,5vw,80px) 0 0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--black);min-height:100vh;min-height:100svh;display:flex;align-items:center;padding:clamp(70px,10vh,120px) 0;overflow:hidden}
.intro::before{content:"";position:absolute;width:90vw;height:90vw;max-width:1300px;max-height:1300px;right:-35vw;top:-18vw;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(24,61,34,.14);box-shadow:0 0 0 70px rgba(124,203,53,.05),0 0 0 140px rgba(124,203,53,.04)}
.intro-inner{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;align-items:center;gap:clamp(20px,4vw,60px)}

.p-head{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto;align-items:end;gap:clamp(16px,3vw,48px);margin-bottom:clamp(12px,2.2vh,24px)}

.p-head .label::before{content:"";width:46px;height:1px;background:var(--deep-green)}
.p-head h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,min(3.2vw,5.6vh),3rem)}
.p-head p{font-size:clamp(.9rem,1.05vw,1rem);color:rgba(7,16,10,.7);max-width:22rem;padding-bottom:.3rem}
.grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:1fr;gap:clamp(10px,1.8vh,22px) clamp(10px,1.4vw,22px)}
.grid>li{min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex}
.grid>li.rv{opacity:0;transform:translate3d(0,90px,0) scale(.94);filter:blur(8px);transition:opacity .8s ease,transform 1s var(--ease),filter .8s ease;transition-delay:var(--card-delay,0s)}
.grid>li.rv.in{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}
.grid>li:nth-child(1){--card-delay:.00s}.grid>li:nth-child(2){--card-delay:.12s}.grid>li:nth-child(3){--card-delay:.24s}.grid>li:nth-child(4){--card-delay:.36s}.grid>li:nth-child(5){--card-delay:.48s}.grid>li:nth-child(6){--card-delay:.60s}.grid>li:nth-child(7){--card-delay:.72s}.grid>li:nth-child(8){--card-delay:.84s}.grid>li:nth-child(9){--card-delay:.96s}

/* =========================================================
   7. PRODUCT CARDS (portrait layout: number on top, title at the bottom)
   ========================================================= */
.card{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;gap:.6rem;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;padding:clamp(16px,3vh,32px) clamp(16px,1.8vw,30px);color:var(--black);border-radius:22px;border:1px solid rgba(124,203,53,.5);background:linear-gradient(155deg,#fff,rgba(243,240,231,.85));overflow:hidden;transition:transform .5s var(--ease),box-shadow .5s,border-color .4s;box-shadow:0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9) inset,0 24px 50px -34px rgba(24,61,34,.55)}

.card:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--deep-green);outline-offset:4px}
.card-bg{position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:inherit;overflow:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.card-bg::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:-60px;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(24,61,34,.075) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(24,61,34,.075) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:32px 32px;transition:transform 1.4s var(--ease)}

.card-bg::after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-70px;top:-70px;width:min(260px,70%);aspect-ratio:1;border-radius:50%;background:repeating-radial-gradient(circle at center,transparent 0 16px,rgba(124,203,53,.28) 17px 18px);animation:ringpulse 6s ease-in-out infinite;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.card:hover .card-bg::after{transform:scale(1.35) rotate(40deg)}
@keyframes ringpulse{50%{opacity:.5}}
.card-line{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;height:3px;width:100%;background:var(--green);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:0 50%;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
.card:hover .card-line{transform:scaleX(1)}
.card-top{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start}
.card-num{font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,min(4.6vw,9vh),4.8rem);line-height:.85;letter-spacing:-.04em;color:transparent;-webkit-text-stroke:1.2px rgba(24,61,34,.5);transition:transform .7s var(--ease),color .4s,-webkit-text-stroke-color .4s}
.card:hover .card-num{transform:translate(8px,-6px);color:var(--green);-webkit-text-stroke-color:var(--green)}
.card-arrow{display:grid;place-items:center;width:clamp(34px,3vw,44px);height:clamp(34px,3vw,44px);border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(24,61,34,.35);transition:background .4s,border-color .4s,transform .6s var(--ease)}
.card-arrow svg{width:40%;height:40%}
.card:hover .card-arrow{background:var(--green);border-color:var(--green);transform:rotate(45deg)}
.card-bottom{position:relative;display:block}
.card-name{display:block;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;font-size:clamp(1.25rem,min(2.3vw,4.4vh),2.2rem);letter-spacing:-.03em;line-height:1.08}
.card-cat{display:block;margin-top:.4rem;font-size:clamp(.82rem,1.05vw,1rem);color:rgba(7,16,10,.72);line-height:1.35}
.card-cta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.6rem;margin-top:clamp(8px,1.8vh,18px);font-family:var(--mono);font-size:.68rem;letter-spacing:.14em;font-weight:600;color:var(--deep-green)}
.card-cta svg{width:16px;height:16px;transition:transform .5s var(--ease)}
.card:hover .card-cta svg{transform:translateX(8px)}
.card .p{position:absolute;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);opacity:0;box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--green);pointer-events:none}
.card:hover .p{animation:rise 2.2s ease-out infinite;animation-delay:var(--dl)}
@keyframes rise{0%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(20px)}25%{opacity:1}100%{opacity:0;transform:translateY(-90px)}}

/* desktop + tablet: LARGE PRODUCT CARDS */
@media (min-width:721px){
  /* Let the product section grow so the cards are genuinely large instead of being
     squeezed into one viewport. */
  .products{
    height:auto;
    min-height:100svh;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .products .wrap{
    flex:0 0 auto;
    min-height:0;
  }
  .grid{
    width:100%;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));
    grid-template-rows:repeat(3,360px);
    grid-auto-rows:360px;
    row-gap:20px;
    column-gap:42px;
  }
  .grid>li{
    width:100%;
    height:360px;
    min-height:360px;
  }
  .card{
    min-height:100%;
    padding:clamp(22px,2.2vw,34px) clamp(22px,2.2vw,34px);
    border-radius:28px;
  }
  .card-arrow{
    width:clamp(44px,3.5vw,58px);
    height:clamp(44px,3.5vw,58px);
  }
  .card-name{
    font-size:clamp(1.6rem,2.35vw,2.45rem);
  }
  .card-cat{
    font-size:clamp(.95rem,1.15vw,1.15rem);
  }
}

@media (min-width:721px) and (max-height:720px){.card-cta{display:none}}
@media (min-width:721px) and (max-height:600px){.card-cat{display:none}}

/* =========================================================

   ========================================================= */

.d-bar>*{pointer-events:auto}

.d-close:hover{background:var(--bright-green);color:var(--black);border-color:var(--bright-green)}

.d-rule{position:absolute;left:calc(var(--gutter) - 22px);top:22%;bottom:12%;width:1px;background:linear-gradient(var(--bright-green),transparent);transform:scaleY(0);transform-origin:top;transition:transform 1.6s var(--ease) .7s}

.detail.in .d-num{transform:none;opacity:1}
.d-cat{margin-top:clamp(14px,2vw,26px);color:var(--bright-green);opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);transition:opacity .9s ease .8s,transform .9s var(--ease) .8s}
.detail.in .d-cat{opacity:1;transform:none}
.d-title{margin-top:.5rem;font-family:var(--display);font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.04em;line-height:1.03;font-size:clamp(2rem,min(5.4vw,9vh),5rem)}
.dw{display:inline-block;overflow:hidden;padding:.02em .06em .1em 0;margin-right:.2em;vertical-align:top}
