.d-hint i{display:block;width:1px;height:38px;background:linear-gradient(var(--bright-green),transparent);transform-origin:top;animation:hint 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
.d-grid{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(12,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;min-height:auto;align-content:center;width:min(1240px,calc(100% - 2*var(--gutter)));margin:0 auto;padding:70px 0 34px}

.dr-head{position:relative;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px}

/* mono technical labels (reference-site style) */
.label,.btn,.chips li,.card-cta,.d-label,.d-close,.d-nav small,.tlabel,.gpanel{font-family:var(--mono)}
.tlabel,.gpanel{letter-spacing:.14em}

/* =========================================================
   10. RESPONSIVE
   ========================================================= */
@media (max-width:1100px){
  .d-card.c2,.d-card.c3,.d-card.c4,.d-card.c5{grid-column:span 6}
  .d-card.c5{grid-column:span 12}
}
@media (max-width:900px){
  .tlabel{display:none}
  .intro{min-height:auto;padding:80px 0}
  .d-grid{width:calc(100% - 2*var(--gutter));min-height:auto;padding:20px 0}
  .d-range{min-height:auto}
  .rc-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}
  .rc{aspect-ratio:.78}
  .dr-head{flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start}
  .intro-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .intro-visual{max-width:520px;margin:0 auto}
  .p-head{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .d-canvas{width:100%;height:46%}
  .d-hero{max-width:100%;min-height:auto;justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:calc(46vh)}
  .d-rule{display:none}
  .d-num{font-size:clamp(4rem,22vw,8rem)}
  .final canvas{width:100%;height:52%;right:0;opacity:.6}
  .final{align-items:flex-end}
  .final-inner{padding-top:30vh}
}
@media (max-width:560px){
  .rc-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,340px)}
}
@media (max-width:720px){
  .hero{justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:clamp(96px,17vh,140px)}
  .hero-scene{left:50%;top:76%}
  .hero-foot{bottom:28px}
  .hero-foot .tagline{display:none}
  /* phones: 2 portrait cards per row, last card spans the full width */
  .products{height:auto;min-height:0}
  .grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:auto}
  .grid>li{display:block}
  .card{height:auto;aspect-ratio:3/4}
  .grid>li:last-child{grid-column:1/-1}
  .grid>li:last-child .card{aspect-ratio:auto;min-height:170px}
  .card-name{font-size:1.15rem}
  .card-cat{font-size:.78rem}
  .d-card,.d-card.c1,.d-card.c2,.d-card.c3,.d-card.c4,.d-card.c5{grid-column:span 12}
  .d-list.two{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .d-brand .d-brand-txt{display:none}
  .fc-pos.hide-m,.gp-pos.hide-m{display:none}
  .btn{padding:1.05rem 1.5rem}
}

/* =========================================================
   11. REDUCED MOTION
   ========================================================= */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  html{scroll-behavior:auto}
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.001ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;animation-delay:0s!important;transition-duration:.001ms!important;transition-delay:0s!important}
  .rv{opacity:1;transform:none;filter:none}
  .word,.dw>span{transform:none;opacity:1}
  .tower{animation:none}
  .beam::after,.scroll-hint i,.d-hint i{display:none}
  .detail,.detail.open{transition:none}
}
</style>
</head>

function createStage(canvas, drawFn, { maxDpr = 2, observe = true } = {}) {
  const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
  let w = 1, h = 1, visible = !observe, enabled = true, active = false;
  const t0 = performance.now();
  const api = { mouse: pointer, draw: drawFn, extra: {} };
  const size = () => {
    const r = canvas.getBoundingClientRect(), d = Math.min(devicePixelRatio || 1, maxDpr);

  };
  const render = now => { ctx.clearRect(0, 0, w, h); api.draw(ctx, w, h, (now - t0) / 1000, api); };
  const loop = now => render(now);
  const update = () => {
    const should = visible && enabled;
    if (should && !active) { active = true; reduced ? render(t0 + 2500) : loops.add(loop); }
    else if (!should && active) { active = false; loops.delete(loop); }
  };
  new ResizeObserver(() => { size(); if (reduced && active) render(t0 + 2500); }).observe(canvas);

  api.setEnabled = v => { enabled = v; update(); };
  api.redraw = () => { size(); if (reduced) render(t0 + 2500); };
  update();
  return api;
}

/* ---- Hero particles (2D, parallax) ---- */
function heroParticlesDraw() {
  const N = isMobile() ? 34 : 84, r = seeded(3);

    ps.forEach(p => {

}

/* ---- Intro morphing sphere ↔ lattice (scroll-linked) ---- */
function introDraw(sectionEl) {
  const N = 125, sph = [], lat = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
    const y = 1 - (i / (N - 1)) * 2, rr = Math.sqrt(1 - y * y), th = i * 2.399963;

  }
  const ss = (a, b, x) => { x = clamp((x - a) / (b - a), 0, 1); return x * x * (3 - 2 * x); };
  return (ctx, w, h, t, api) => {
    const r = sectionEl.getBoundingClientRect(), p = clamp((innerHeight - r.top) / (innerHeight + r.height), 0, 1);
    const m = ss(.38, .72, p), rot = p * TAU * 1.1 + t * .12 + api.mouse.x * .4, cam = cam3(w, h, -.3 + api.mouse.y * .2 + p * .3, rot);
    const pos = sph.map((s, i) => [lerp(s[0], lat[i][0], m), lerp(s[1], lat[i][1], m), lerp(s[2], lat[i][2], m)]);
    const P = pos.map(q => cam(q[0], q[1], q[2]));

    for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) for (let j = i + 1; j < N; j++) {

    }
    ctx.stroke();
    // equator rings
    ctx.strokeStyle = DG(.22); poly(ctx, cam, circlePts(0, 0, 0, lerp(235, 150, m), 60, 'xz'), true);
    ctx.strokeStyle = ST(.5); poly(ctx, cam, circlePts(0, 0, 0, lerp(235, 150, m), 60, 'xy').map(q => [q[0], q[1], q[2]]), true);
    P.forEach((q, i) => { glowDot(ctx, q[0], q[1], 5 + q[2] * 7, .35 + .55 * clamp((q[2] - .75) * 1.6, 0, 1)); });
    const pulse = (t * .4) % 1; const c = P[Math.floor(pulse * N)]; glowDot(ctx, c[0], c[1], 26, .8);

    face(cls, `rotateY(90deg) translateZ(${w / 2}px)`, d, h) + face(cls, `rotateY(-90deg) translateZ(${w / 2}px)`, d, h) +
    face('t', `rotateX(90deg) translateZ(${h / 2}px)`, w, d) + face('b', `rotateX(-90deg) translateZ(${h / 2}px)`, w, d);
  const names = ['BUILDING', 'SENSORS', 'CONTROL', 'DATA', 'ENERGY', 'INTELLIGENCE'], widths = [230, 210, 190, 170, 150, 130], STEP = 46, H = 34;

  html += `<div class="tower-wrap"><div class="tower"><i class="core"></i>`;

  html += `</div></div>`;
  // floating cubes
  const cubes = [[-300, -120, 140, 54, 24, 6, 0], [-250, 130, -90, 38, 31, 8, 1.4], [300, -150, 100, 62, 36, 7, .6], [330, 70, -130, 44, 22, 9, 2.1], [-120, -230, -160, 34, 27, 6.5, .9], [140, 210, 190, 48, 33, 7.5, 1.8], [-340, 10, 40, 30, 20, 8.5, 2.6]];

    html += `<div class="fc-pos ${i > 3 ? 'hide-m' : ''}" style="transform:translate3d(${x}px,${y}px,${z}px)"><div class="fc-bob" style="--bd:${bd}s;--dl:${dl}s"><div class="fc ${i % 3 === 0 ? 'solid' : ''}" style="--cs:${cs}s;width:0;height:0">${box(s, s, s)}</div></div></div>`;

  [[-330, -20, -80, -26, 'LIVE SIGNAL', 'SENSOR LAYER'], [290, 210, 40, 22, 'ENERGY FLOW', 'CONTROL LAYER'], [-40, -250, 60, 8, 'OPTIMISE', 'INTELLIGENCE']].forEach(([x, y, z, ry, a, b], i) => {

  const beam = (A, B, dl) => { const dx = B[0] - A[0], dy = B[1] - A[1], dz = B[2] - A[2], hz = Math.hypot(dx, dz), len = Math.hypot(dx, dy, dz); return `<i class="beam" style="--len:${len}px;--dl:${dl}s;width:${len}px;transform:translate3d(${A[0]}px,${A[1]}px,${A[2]}px) rotateY(${Math.atan2(-dz, dx)}rad) rotateZ(${Math.atan2(dy, hz)}rad)"></i>`; };

function initReveal() {

}
function initProgress() {

  addEventListener('scroll', () => { if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(upd); } }, { passive: true }); upd();
}

function initParallax() {

  const scaleScene = () => $('#heroScene').style.setProperty('--sc', getComputedStyle(hero).getPropertyValue('--sc'));

    b.setAttribute('aria-expanded', open); b.querySelector('.t').textContent = open ? 'Close' : 'Details';
  });
  $('#dClose').addEventListener('click', closeDetail);
  $('#dPrev').addEventListener('click', () => switchDetail(-1));
  $('#dNext').addEventListener('click', () => switchDetail(1));
  document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
    if (!detail.classList.contains('open')) return;
    if (e.key === 'Escape') { e.preventDefault(); closeDetail(); return; }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' && !e.target.closest('input,textarea')) { switchDetail(1); return; }
    if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' && !e.target.closest('input,textarea')) { switchDetail(-1); return; }
    if (e.key === 'Tab') {
      const f = $$('button,[href],[tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])', detail).filter(x => !x.disabled && x.offsetParent !== null);
      if (!f.length) return;
      const first = f[0], last = f[f.length - 1];
      if (e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) { e.preventDefault(); last.focus(); }
      else if (!e.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) { e.preventDefault(); first.focus(); }
    }
  });
}

/* ---- hero background helpers ---- */
function buildSkyline() {
  const r = seeded(23); let s = '', x = 0;
  while (x < 1600) { const w = 22 + r() * 46, hgt = 40 + r() * 170; s += `<rect x="${x.toFixed(0)}" y="${(400 - hgt).toFixed(0)}" width="${w.toFixed(0)}" height="${hgt.toFixed(0)}"/>`; x += w + r() * 10; }
  s += '<polygon points="1060,400 1060,170 1068,120 1074,60 1078,14 1082,60 1088,120 1096,170 1096,400"/>';
  $('#skyline').innerHTML = s;
}
function initVideo() {
  const v = $('#heroVideo');
  if (!HERO_VIDEO_MP4 || reduced) return;           // webpage URL is never placed in <video src>
  v.src = HERO_VIDEO_MP4;
  v.addEventListener('canplay', () => { v.classList.add('has-src'); v.play().catch(() => {}); }, { once: true });
  v.load();
}

/* ---- boot ---- */
function boot() {
  renderCards(); buildSkyline(); buildScene(); initVideo();
  createStage($('#heroParticles'), heroParticlesDraw());
  createStage($('#introCanvas'), introDraw($('#intro')));
  const fin = createStage($('#finalCanvas'), V.finalBuilding());
  const finalEl = $('#final');
  loops.add(() => { const r = finalEl.getBoundingClientRect(); fin.extra.p = clamp((innerHeight - r.top) / (innerHeight + r.height), 0, 1); });
  initReveal(); initProgress(); initParallax(); initNav(); initDetailEvents();
  const go = () => requestAnimationFrame(() => requestAnimationFrame(() => document.body.classList.add('is-ready')));
  const fonts = document.fonts && document.fonts.ready ? document.fonts.ready : Promise.resolve();
  Promise.race([fonts, new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 1400))]).then(go);
}
if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot); else boot();
})();
</script>

/* =========================================================
   NEWS CARD UPGRADE — FLEX CTA + INTERACTIVE DEPTH
   The content area grows with the copy, while the CTA is
   kept in normal document flow at the bottom of the card.
========================================================= */

.news-card {
    --mx: 50%;
    --my: 50%;
    --tilt-x: 0deg;
    --tilt-y: 0deg;

    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    isolation: isolate;
    transform-style: preserve-3d;
    will-change: transform;
    transition:
        transform .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
        box-shadow .55s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
        border-color .4s ease;
}

.news-card::before {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 4;
    pointer-events: none;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background:
        radial-gradient(
            360px circle at var(--mx) var(--my),
            rgba(111,174,69,.14),
            transparent 62%
        );
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity .35s ease;
}

.news-card::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 5;
    pointer-events: none;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background:
        linear-gradient(
            115deg,
            transparent 20%,
            rgba(255,255,255,.16) 47%,
            transparent 58%
        );
    transform: translateX(-125%);
    transition: transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}

.news-card:hover,
.news-card.is-hovered {
    transform:
        perspective(1100px)
        rotateX(var(--tilt-x))
        rotateY(var(--tilt-y))
        translateY(-10px)
        scale(1.008);
    box-shadow:
        0 34px 80px rgba(15,35,20,.16),
        0 0 0 1px rgba(111,174,69,.12);
    border-color: rgba(79,143,50,.24);
}

.news-card:hover::before,
.news-card.is-hovered::before {
    opacity: 1;
}

.news-card:hover::after,
.news-card.is-hovered::after {
    transform: translateX(125%);
}

.news-visual {
    flex: 0 0 240px;
    position: relative;
    z-index: 1;
    transform: translateZ(8px);
}

.featured .news-visual {
    flex-basis: 280px;
}

.news-content {
    position: relative;
    z-index: 2;
    display: flex;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-height: 0;
    padding: clamp(22px,2.4vw,30px);
    transform: translateZ(14px);
}

.news-content p {
    max-width: 46ch;
}

/* Real button, normal flow — no absolute positioning, so longer copy is safe. */
.read-more {
    position: static;
    left: auto;
    bottom: auto;
    margin-top: auto;
    padding: 11px 15px 11px 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    align-self: flex-start;
    gap: 9px;
    min-height: 40px;
    color: var(--green-dark);
    font-family: var(--go-mono, "JetBrains Mono", monospace);
    font-size: .68rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    line-height: 1;
    letter-spacing: .1em;
    text-transform: uppercase;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition:
        color .35s ease,
        gap .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
        transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}

.featured .read-more {
    color: var(--green-soft);
}

.read-more::before {
    content: "";
    width: 26px;
    height: 1px;
    background: currentColor;
    opacity: .5;
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition:
        width .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
        opacity .35s ease;
}

.read-more-arrow {
    display: inline-block;
    font-size: 15px;
    line-height: 1;
    transition: transform .35s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}

.read-more:hover,
.read-more:focus-visible,
.news-card:hover .read-more {
    color: var(--green);
    gap: 12px;
    outline: none;
}

.featured .read-more:hover,
.featured .read-more:focus-visible,
.news-card.featured:hover .read-more {
    color: var(--green-light);
}

.read-more:hover::before,
.read-more:focus-visible::before,
.news-card:hover .read-more::before {
    width: 38px;
    opacity: .9;
}

.read-more:hover .read-more-arrow,
.read-more:focus-visible .read-more-arrow,
.news-card:hover .read-more-arrow {
    transform: translate(3px,-3px);
}

/* Subtle architectural motion inside the card artwork. */
.news-card .building-lines {
    transition:
        transform .75s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1),
        box-shadow .75s ease,
        border-color .5s ease;
    will-change: transform;
}

.news-card:hover .building-lines,
.news-card.is-hovered .building-lines {
    transform:
        translate(-50%,-45%)
        perspective(500px)
        rotateX(8deg)
        rotateY(-14deg)
        translateZ(18px)
        scale(1.035);
    box-shadow:
        0 0 90px rgba(79,143,50,.22),
        inset 0 0 35px rgba(111,174,69,.04);
}

.news-card .news-visual::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    pointer-events: none;
    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 50% 50%,
            rgba(111,174,69,.08),
            transparent 48%
        );
    opacity: 0;
    transform: scale(.7);
    transition:
        opacity .6s ease,
        transform .8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);
}

.news-card:hover .news-visual::after,
.news-card.is-hovered .news-visual::after {
    opacity: 1;
    transform: scale(1.15);
}

/* Keep the animation elegant for touch devices and accessibility preferences. */
@media (max-width: 900px) {
    .news-card:hover,
    .news-card.is-hovered {
        transform: translateY(-6px);
    }

    .news-card::before,
    .news-card::after {
        display: none;
    }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
    .news-card,
    .news-card::before,
    .news-card::after,
    .news-card .building-lines,
    .read-more,
    .read-more::before,
    .read-more-arrow {
        transition: none !important;
    }
}


/* =========================================================
   V2 — MOTION LAYER, EVENT IMAGE CARDS, PERF/A11Y FIXES
========================================================= */
:root{--ease:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}
.cursor,.cursor-ring{left:0;top:0;will-change:transform}

/* scroll reveal — uses the independent `translate` property so card hover transforms never conflict */
.rv{opacity:0;translate:0 36px;transition:opacity .9s var(--ease) var(--d,0s),translate .9s var(--ease) var(--d,0s)}
.rv.in{opacity:1;translate:0 0}
.news-card.rv{transition:opacity .9s var(--ease) var(--d,0s),translate .9s var(--ease) var(--d,0s),transform .55s var(--ease),box-shadow .55s var(--ease),border-color .4s ease}

/* label rules draw in, hero rule grows, building art breathes */
.section-label,.events-label{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}
.section-label::before,.events-label::before{content:"";width:0;height:1px;background:currentColor;transition:width .9s .25s var(--ease)}
.rv.in .section-label::before,.rv.in .events-label::before{width:28px}
.eyebrow-line{transform-origin:left;animation:lineGrow 1s .2s var(--ease) both}
@keyframes lineGrow{from{transform:scaleX(0)}}
@keyframes bFloat{50%{translate:0 -6px}}
.news-card .building-lines{animation:bFloat 7s ease-in-out infinite}
.news-card:nth-child(2) .building-lines{animation-delay:-2.2s}
.news-card:nth-child(3) .building-lines{animation-delay:-4.4s}

/* EVENTS — white slider cards (match news cards: white, dark text, green only as accent) */
.events-section{background:#0b0c0b}
.events-section::before{background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(111,174,69,.07),transparent 65%)}
.events-list{display:flex;gap:clamp(14px,1.6vw,22px);overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-x:contain;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;scrollbar-width:none;
  padding:24px 0 40px;margin:-24px 0 -12px;position:relative;z-index:2;cursor:grab}
.events-list::-webkit-scrollbar{display:none}
.events-list.dragging{cursor:grabbing;scroll-snap-type:none;user-select:none}
.events-list.dragging .event{pointer-events:none}
@keyframes evIn{from{opacity:0;translate:80px 0}}
.events-list.in .event{animation:evIn 1s var(--ease) calc(var(--i,0)*.1s) backwards}

.event{--mx:50%;--my:50%;flex:0 0 clamp(272px,28vw,372px);scroll-snap-align:start;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  background:#fff;color:var(--text-dark);border:1px solid var(--border-light);border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;cursor:pointer;
  transition:transform .6s var(--ease),box-shadow .6s var(--ease),border-color .4s ease,opacity .5s ease,scale .6s var(--ease)}
.events-list.ready .event:not(.is-active){opacity:.5;scale:.965}
.event::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:3;pointer-events:none;border-radius:inherit;background:radial-gradient(320px circle at var(--mx) var(--my),rgba(79,143,50,.09),transparent 62%);opacity:0;transition:opacity .35s ease}
.event::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:4;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(115deg,transparent 25%,rgba(79,143,50,.09) 48%,transparent 60%);transform:translateX(-130%);transition:transform .9s var(--ease)}
.event:hover,.event:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-8px);border-color:rgba(79,143,50,.35);box-shadow:0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.45);outline:none}
.event:focus-visible{box-shadow:0 0 0 3px rgba(167,232,91,.7),0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.event:hover::before,.event:focus-visible::before{opacity:1}
.event:hover::after,.event:focus-visible::after{transform:translateX(130%)}

.event-media{position:relative;aspect-ratio:16/11;overflow:hidden;background:#0a120b;flex:none}
.event-media::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:1;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(5,7,5,.22),transparent 40%,rgba(5,7,5,.55))}
.event-img,.event-art{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%}
.event-img{object-fit:cover;transform:scale(1.02);transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.event:hover .event-img,.event:focus-visible .event-img{transform:scale(1.1) translate(-1.5%,-1%)}

.ea-grid{position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(111,174,69,.07) 1px,transparent 1px),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(111,174,69,.07) 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:28px 28px;transition:transform 1.2s var(--ease)}
.event:hover .ea-grid{transform:scale(1.15)}
.ea-b{position:absolute;bottom:0;left:var(--l);width:15%;height:var(--h);border:1px solid rgba(111,174,69,.45);border-bottom:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(0deg,transparent 0 13px,rgba(111,174,69,.16) 14px),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(111,174,69,.14),transparent);transform-origin:bottom;transform:scaleY(.9);transition:transform .9s var(--ease) var(--bd,0s)}
.event:hover .ea-b,.event:focus-visible .ea-b{transform:scaleY(1.12)}

.event-arrow{position:absolute;top:12px;right:12px;z-index:3;width:38px;height:38px;margin:0;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.95);color:var(--green-dark);transition:transform .5s var(--ease),background .35s ease,color .35s ease}
.event:hover .event-arrow,.event:focus-visible .event-arrow{transform:rotate(45deg) scale(1.08);background:var(--green-dark);color:#fff}
.event-more{position:absolute;left:14px;bottom:14px;z-index:3;padding:7px 13px;border-radius:99px;background:var(--text-dark);color:#fff;font-family:var(--go-mono);font-size:.62rem;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;transform:translateY(140%);opacity:0;transition:transform .55s var(--ease),opacity .4s ease}
.event:hover .event-more,.event:focus-visible .event-more{transform:none;opacity:1}

.event-body{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1;padding:22px 24px 22px}
.event-city{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-bottom:12px;font-family:var(--go-mono);font-size:.64rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted-dark)}
.event-city::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--green);animation:pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes pulse{50%{opacity:.35;transform:scale(.7)}}
.event-body h3{font-family:var(--go-font);font-size:clamp(20px,1.8vw,24px);line-height:1.3;letter-spacing:-.025em;font-weight:600;margin-bottom:10px;color:var(--text-dark);transition:color .35s ease}
.event:hover h3,.event:focus-visible h3{color:var(--green)}
.event-body p{color:var(--muted-dark);font-size:clamp(15px,1vw,16px);line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:22px}
.event-venue{position:relative;margin-top:auto;padding-top:14px;font-size:13px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;color:var(--text-dark)}
.event-venue::before,.event-venue::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;height:1px;width:100%}
.event-venue::before{background:var(--border-light)}
.event-venue::after{background:var(--green);transform:scaleX(0);transform-origin:left;transition:transform .8s var(--ease)}
.event:hover .event-venue::after,.event:focus-visible .event-venue::after{transform:scaleX(1)}
@media(hover:none){.event-more{transform:none;opacity:1}}

/* slider controls */
.events-tools{position:relative;z-index:2;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:clamp(14px,2vw,28px)}
.ev-count{font-family:var(--go-mono);font-size:.72rem;letter-spacing:.1em;color:rgba(247,248,244,.55);min-width:62px}
.ev-bar{flex:1;height:2px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);border-radius:2px;overflow:hidden}
.ev-bar i{display:block;height:100%;width:0;background:var(--go-bright);transition:width .35s ease}
.ev-btns{display:flex;gap:10px}
.ev-btns button{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.2);background:transparent;color:#fff;font-size:18px;line-height:1;cursor:pointer;transition:background .3s ease,color .3s ease,transform .3s var(--ease),opacity .3s}
.ev-btns button:hover:not(:disabled){background:#fff;color:#0b0c0b;transform:scale(1.06)}
.ev-btns button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.ev-btns button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--go-bright);outline-offset:3px}

/* newsletter: neutral dark instead of full green; green stays as accent */

/* modal image + focus */
.modal-media{display:none;clear:both;margin:18px 0 4px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#0a120b}
.modal-media.on{display:block}
.modal-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}
.modal-close:focus-visible,.read-more:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--green);outline-offset:3px}

/* reduced motion: everything calm and visible */
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){
  *,*::before,*::after{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-iteration-count:1!important;transition-duration:.01ms!important}
  .rv{opacity:1;translate:none}
}
</style>

<script>
(function(){
"use strict";
var $=function(s,r){return(r||document).querySelector(s)},
    $$=function(s,r){return Array.prototype.slice.call((r||document).querySelectorAll(s))};
var fine=matchMedia("(pointer:fine)").matches,
    reduce=matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce)").matches;

/* CURSOR — one rAF loop, transform only (was: a new Web Animation on every mousemove) */
var dot=$(".cursor"),ring=$(".cursor-ring");
if(fine&&!reduce){
  var mx=0,my=0,rx=0,ry=0,raf=0;
  var loop=function(){
    rx+=(mx-rx)*.18;ry+=(my-ry)*.18;
    ring.style.transform="translate3d("+rx+"px,"+ry+"px,0) translate(-50%,-50%)";
    raf=(Math.abs(mx-rx)>.3||Math.abs(my-ry)>.3)?requestAnimationFrame(loop):0;
  };
  document.addEventListener("mousemove",function(e){
    mx=e.clientX;my=e.clientY;
    dot.style.transform="translate3d("+mx+"px,"+my+"px,0) translate(-50%,-50%)";
    if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(loop);
  },{passive:true});
}else{dot.style.display=ring.style.display="none"}

/* HERO PARALLAX — `translate` property in rAF (was: margin changes = layout every move) */
var orbit=$(".hero-orbit");
if(orbit&&fine&&!reduce){
  var pf=0,px=0,py=0;
  addEventListener("mousemove",function(e){
    px=(e.clientX/innerWidth-.5)*18;py=(e.clientY/innerHeight-.5)*12;
    if(!pf)pf=requestAnimationFrame(function(){orbit.style.translate=px+"px "+py+"px";pf=0});
  },{passive:true});
}

/* EVENT IMAGES — add data-image="URL" to any .event; placeholder art hides once it loads */
$$(".event").forEach(function(ev){
  var u=ev.getAttribute("data-image");if(!u)return;
  var m=$(".event-media",ev),art=$(".event-art",ev),im=new Image();
  im.className="event-img";im.alt="";im.loading="lazy";im.referrerPolicy="no-referrer";
  im.onload=function(){if(art)art.style.display="none"};
  im.onerror=function(){im.remove()};
  im.src=u;m.insertBefore(im,m.firstChild);
});

/* MODAL */
var modal=$("#contentModal"),mT=$("#modalTitle"),mD=$("#modalDate"),mP=$("#modalDescription"),mC=$("#modalClose"),mM=$("#modalMedia"),last=null;
function openModal(card){
  mT.textContent=card.dataset.title;mD.textContent=card.dataset.date;mP.textContent=card.dataset.description;
  var u=card.dataset.image;mM.innerHTML="";mM.classList.toggle("on",!!u);
  if(u){var i=new Image();i.alt="";i.referrerPolicy="no-referrer";i.onerror=function(){mM.classList.remove("on");i.remove()};i.src=u;mM.appendChild(i)}
  last=card;modal.classList.add("active");document.body.style.overflow="hidden";mC.focus();
}
function closeModal(){
  modal.classList.remove("active");document.body.style.overflow="";
  if(last&&last.focus)last.focus({preventScroll:true});
}
$$(".news-card,.event").forEach(function(c){c.addEventListener("click",function(){openModal(c)})});
$$(".event").forEach(function(ev){   /* events have no inner button, so make the card itself keyboard-operable */
  ev.tabIndex=0;ev.setAttribute("role","button");ev.setAttribute("aria-label",ev.dataset.title+", "+ev.dataset.date);
  ev.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Enter"||e.key===" "){e.preventDefault();openModal(ev)}});
});
mC.addEventListener("click",closeModal);
modal.addEventListener("click",function(e){if(e.target===modal)closeModal()});
document.addEventListener("keydown",function(e){if(e.key==="Escape"&&modal.classList.contains("active"))closeModal()});

/* NEWSLETTER */
var form=$("#newsletterForm"),email=$("#newsletterEmail"),ok=$("#successMessage");
if(form)form.addEventListener("submit",function(e){
  e.preventDefault();if(!email.value.trim())return;
  ok.classList.add("show");email.value="";setTimeout(function(){ok.classList.remove("show")},3500);
});

/* POINTER MOTION — news cards: spotlight + restrained tilt; event cards: spotlight */
if(fine&&!reduce){
  $$(".news-card").forEach(function(card){
    var raf=0,tx=0,ty=0,cx=0,cy=0;
    var step=function(){
      cx+=(tx-cx)*.12;cy+=(ty-cy)*.12;
      card.style.setProperty("--tilt-x",(cy*-4)+"deg");card.style.setProperty("--tilt-y",(cx*4)+"deg");
      raf=(Math.abs(tx-cx)>.001||Math.abs(ty-cy)>.001)?requestAnimationFrame(step):0;
    };
    card.addEventListener("pointermove",function(e){
      if(innerWidth<900||e.pointerType==="touch")return;
      var r=card.getBoundingClientRect(),x=e.clientX-r.left,y=e.clientY-r.top;
      tx=x/r.width-.5;ty=y/r.height-.5;
      card.style.setProperty("--mx",x+"px");card.style.setProperty("--my",y+"px");
      card.classList.add("is-hovered");if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(step);
    });
    var reset=function(){tx=ty=0;card.classList.remove("is-hovered");if(!raf)raf=requestAnimationFrame(step)};
    card.addEventListener("pointerleave",reset);card.addEventListener("pointercancel",reset);
  });
  $$(".event").forEach(function(ev){
    ev.addEventListener("pointermove",function(e){
      var r=ev.getBoundingClientRect();
      ev.style.setProperty("--mx",(e.clientX-r.left)+"px");ev.style.setProperty("--my",(e.clientY-r.top)+"px");
    });
  });
}

/* EVENTS SLIDER — native scroll-snap + buttons, progress bar, mouse drag, active-card focus */
var track=$("#evTrack");
if(track){
  var cards=$$(".event",track),prev=$("#evPrev"),next=$("#evNext"),bar=$("#evBar"),cnt=$("#evCount"),uf=0;
  cards.forEach(function(c,i){c.style.setProperty("--i",i)});
  var step=function(){return cards[1]?cards[1].offsetLeft-cards[0].offsetLeft:cards[0].offsetWidth};
  var pad=function(n){return("0"+n).slice(-2)};
  var update=function(){
    uf=0;var l=track.scrollLeft,max=track.scrollWidth-track.clientWidth;
    bar.style.width=((l+track.clientWidth)/track.scrollWidth*100)+"%";
    prev.disabled=l<=2;next.disabled=l>=max-2;
    cnt.textContent=pad(Math.min(cards.length,Math.round(l/step())+1))+" / "+pad(cards.length);
  };
  var go=function(d){track.scrollBy({left:d*step(),behavior:reduce?"auto":"smooth"})};
  prev.addEventListener("click",function(){go(-1)});next.addEventListener("click",function(){go(1)});

<!DOCTYPE html>

        ====================================================== */

<script>


/* =============================================================
   SCROLL REVEAL
============================================================= */

(function () {


    const page =
        document.querySelector(
            "#tridium-product-page"
        );


    if (!page) {
        return;
    }


    const revealItems =
        page.querySelectorAll(
            ".tri-feature, .tri-capability, .tri-product-card"
        );


    const revealObserver =
        new IntersectionObserver(

            function (entries) {


                entries.forEach(
                    function (entry) {


                        if (
                            entry.isIntersecting
                        ) {


                            entry.target.classList.add(
                                "tri-visible"
                            );


                            revealObserver.unobserve(
                                entry.target
                            );

                        }

                    }
                );

            },

            {
                threshold:
                    .12
            }

        );


    revealItems.forEach(
        function (item) {

            revealObserver.observe(
                item
            );

        }
    );



    /* =========================================================
       HERO MOUSE PARALLAX
    ========================================================== */


    const opening =
        page.querySelector(
            ".tri-opening"
        );


    const network =
        page.querySelector(
            ".tri-network-scene"
        );


    if (
        opening &&
        network &&
        window.matchMedia(
            "(pointer:fine)"
        ).matches
    ) {


        opening.addEventListener(
            "mousemove",
            function (event) {


                const rect =
                    opening.getBoundingClientRect();


                const x =
                    (event.clientX - rect.left)
                    /
                    rect.width
                    -
                    .5;


                const y =
                    (event.clientY - rect.top)
                    /
                    rect.height
                    -
                    .5;


                network.style.transform =
                    `
                    translateY(-50%)
                    translate(
                        ${x * 16}px,
                        ${y * 16}px
                    )
                    `;

            }
        );


        opening.addEventListener(
            "mouseleave",
            function () {

                network.style.transform =
                    "translateY(-50%)";

            }
        );

    }



    /* =========================================================
       PRODUCT CARD TILT
    ========================================================== */


    const productCards =
        page.querySelectorAll(
            ".tri-product-card"
        );


    productCards.forEach(
        function (card) {


            card.addEventListener(
                "mousemove",
                function (event) {


                    if (
                        !window.matchMedia(
                            "(pointer:fine)"
                        ).matches
                    ) {
                        return;
                    }


                    const rect =
                        card.getBoundingClientRect();


                    const x =
                        event.clientX -
                        rect.left;


                    const y =
                        event.clientY -
                        rect.top;


                    const rotateY =
                        ((x / rect.width) - .5)
                        *
                        4;


                    const rotateX =
                        ((y / rect.height) - .5)
                        *
                        -4;


                    card.style.transform =
                        `
                        translateY(-8px)
                        perspective(1000px)
                        rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
                        rotateY(${rotateY}deg)
                        `;

                }
            );


            card.addEventListener(
                "mouseleave",
                function () {

                    card.style.transform =
                        "";

                }
            );

        }
    );



    /* =========================================================
       SCROLL INDICATOR
    ========================================================== */


    const scrollIndicator =
        page.querySelector(
            ".tri-scroll-indicator"
        );


    if (scrollIndicator) {


        scrollIndicator.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {


                const intro =
                    page.querySelector(
                        ".tri-intro"
                    );


                if (intro) {


                    intro.scrollIntoView({
                        behavior:
                            "smooth"
                    });

                }

            }
        );

    }


})();

</script>

<style>
:root{
    --green:#3fae68;
    --green-light:#6bd792;
    --green-dark:#0d3924;
    --black:#07100c;
    --black2:#0a1510;
    --cream:#f2f3ed;
    --white:#fff;
    --muted:#aeb8b1;
    --line:rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}

*{margin:0;padding:0;box-sizing:border-box}

html{scroll-behavior:smooth}

body{
    margin:0;
    background:var(--black);
    color:#fff;
    font-family:"Inter",sans-serif;
    overflow-x:hidden;
}

a{
    text-decoration:none;
    color:inherit;
}

/* =========================================================
   HERO
========================================================= */

.ibms-hero{
    min-height:100vh;
    height:100vh;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(4,10,7,.96) 0%,
            rgba(4,10,7,.89) 37%,
            rgba(4,10,7,.48) 62%,
            rgba(4,10,7,.12) 100%
        ),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1486406146926-c627a92ad1ab?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2400&q=90");

    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
}

.ibms-hero::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at 77% 48%,
            rgba(63,190,111,.25),
            transparent 28%
        ),
        linear-gradient(
            180deg,
            rgba(0,0,0,.18),
            rgba(0,0,0,.38)
        );
    pointer-events:none;
}

/* Moving technical grid */
.hero-grid{
    position:absolute;
    inset:0;
    opacity:.13;

    background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(79,202,119,.28) 1px,transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(79,202,119,.28) 1px,transparent 1px);

    background-size:65px 65px;

    transform:
        perspective(700px)
        rotateX(58deg)
        scale(1.7);

    transform-origin:center bottom;

    animation:gridMove 15s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes gridMove{
    from{background-position:0 0}
    to{background-position:0 650px}
}

/* Hero text */
.hero-content{
    position:relative;
    z-index:5;
    width:min(1150px,90%);
    margin-left:7.8%;
    padding-top:2vh;
}

.hero-tag{
    display:inline-flex;
    align-items:center;
    padding:8px 18px;

    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.7);
    border-radius:30px;

    font-size:12px;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.08em;
    text-transform:uppercase;

    margin-bottom:22px;

    backdrop-filter:blur(10px);
    background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);
}

.hero-title{
    font-family:"Inter",sans-serif;
    font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,68px);
    line-height:1.03;
    letter-spacing:-.045em;
    font-weight:700;

    max-width:650px;
    margin-bottom:22px;
}

.hero-title span{
    color:var(--green);
}

.hero-description{
    font-size:17px;
    line-height:1.65;
    color:#e7ebe8;
    max-width:570px;
    font-weight:500;
    margin-bottom:30px;
}

.hero-actions{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:22px;
}

.primary-btn{
    background:#fff;
    color:#29a95d;

    padding:14px 27px;
    border-radius:30px;

    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:700;

    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:12px;

    transition:.3s ease;
}

.primary-btn span{
    font-size:20px;
}

.primary-btn:hover{
    transform:translateY(-3px);
    box-shadow:0 15px 40px rgba(0,0,0,.3);
}

.secondary-btn{
    font-size:15px;
    font-weight:600;

    color:#fff;

    border-bottom:1px solid #fff;
    padding-bottom:5px;

    transition:.3s;
}

.secondary-btn:hover{
    color:var(--green-light);
    border-color:var(--green-light);
}

/* =========================================================
   3D BUILDING SYSTEM VISUAL
========================================================= */

.ibms-visual{
    position:absolute;

    right:1%;
    top:50%;

    width:51vw;
    height:51vw;

    max-width:700px;
    max-height:700px;

    transform:translateY(-50%);

    perspective:1400px;

    transition:transform .25s ease-out;

    z-index:3;
}

/* central building */
.building{
    position:absolute;

    left:50%;
    top:52%;

    width:310px;
    height:310px;

    transform:
        translate(-50%,-50%)
        rotateX(58deg)
        rotateZ(-5deg)
        skewX(-5deg);

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(19,93,55,.15),
            rgba(91,223,139,.25)
        );

    border:1px solid rgba(107,236,151,.75);

    box-shadow:
        0 0 25px rgba(67,215,125,.35),
        inset 0 0 50px rgba(53,190,105,.15);

    animation:buildingFloat 5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes buildingFloat{
    0%,100%{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(58deg)
            rotateZ(-5deg)
            skewX(-5deg)
            translateY(0);
    }

    50%{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(58deg)
            rotateZ(-5deg)
            skewX(-5deg)
            translateY(-15px);
    }
}

/* building floors */
.floor{
    position:absolute;
    left:0;
    width:100%;
    height:1px;
    background:rgba(111,235,153,.65);
}

.floor:nth-child(1){top:12%}
.floor:nth-child(2){top:25%}
.floor:nth-child(3){top:38%}
.floor:nth-child(4){top:51%}
.floor:nth-child(5){top:64%}
.floor:nth-child(6){top:77%}
.floor:nth-child(7){top:90%}

/* building verticals */
.vertical{
    position:absolute;
    top:0;
    width:1px;
    height:100%;
    background:rgba(111,235,153,.5);
}

.vertical:nth-of-type(8){left:15%}
.vertical:nth-of-type(9){left:30%}
.vertical:nth-of-type(10){left:45%}
.vertical:nth-of-type(11){left:60%}
.vertical:nth-of-type(12){left:75%}
.vertical:nth-of-type(13){left:90%}

/* floor light windows */
.window{
    position:absolute;

    width:8px;
    height:8px;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:#8affb1;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 12px #68e899,
        0 0 28px rgba(80,225,130,.8);

    animation:windowPulse 2.7s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes windowPulse{
    0%,100%{opacity:.25;transform:scale(.65)}
    50%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.2)}
}

/* network nodes */
.network-node{
    position:absolute;

    width:15px;
    height:15px;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:#75efa0;

    box-shadow:
        0 0 12px #55df88,
        0 0 35px rgba(80,225,130,.8);

    animation:nodePulse 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes nodePulse{
    0%,100%{
        transform:scale(.8);
        opacity:.55;
    }

    50%{
        transform:scale(1.45);
        opacity:1;
    }
}

.nn1{top:15%;left:27%}
.nn2{top:28%;right:9%;animation-delay:.4s}
.nn3{bottom:20%;left:12%;animation-delay:.8s}
.nn4{bottom:10%;right:22%;animation-delay:1.2s}
.nn5{top:50%;left:3%;animation-delay:1.6s}
.nn6{top:7%;right:29%;animation-delay:2s}
.nn7{top:37%;right:32%;animation-delay:2.4s}

/* network connection lines */
.connection{
    position:absolute;

    height:1px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            transparent,
            rgba(75,232,135,.85),
            transparent
        );

    transform-origin:left center;

    animation:connectionPulse 3s ease-in-out infinite;
}

.line1{
    width:280px;
    top:28%;
    left:27%;
    transform:rotate(20deg);
}

.line2{
    width:310px;
    top:52%;
    left:10%;
    transform:rotate(-12deg);
}

.line3{
    width:300px;
    top:62%;
    left:42%;
    transform:rotate(25deg);
}

.line4{
    width:220px;
    top:35%;
    left:48%;
    transform:rotate(-30deg);
}

@keyframes connectionPulse{
    0%,100%{opacity:.2}
    50%{opacity:1}
}

/* Orbit rings */
.system-orbit{
    position:absolute;

    left:50%;
    top:50%;

    border:1px solid rgba(89,229,139,.45);
    border-radius:50%;
}

.system-orbit.one{
    width:400px;
    height:160px;

    transform:
        translate(-50%,-50%)
        rotateX(68deg)
        rotateZ(15deg);

    animation:orbitA 13s linear infinite;
}

.system-orbit.two{
    width:500px;
    height:210px;

    transform:
        translate(-50%,-50%)
        rotateX(70deg)
        rotateZ(-22deg);

    animation:orbitB 17s linear infinite reverse;
}

.system-orbit.three{
    width:590px;
    height:255px;

    transform:
        translate(-50%,-50%)
        rotateX(72deg)
        rotateZ(35deg);

    opacity:.5;

    animation:orbitC 21s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes orbitA{
    from{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(68deg)
            rotateZ(15deg)
            rotateZ(0);
    }

    to{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(68deg)
            rotateZ(15deg)
            rotateZ(360deg);
    }
}

@keyframes orbitB{
    from{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(70deg)
            rotateZ(-22deg)
            rotateZ(0);
    }

    to{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(70deg)
            rotateZ(-22deg)
            rotateZ(360deg);
    }
}

@keyframes orbitC{
    from{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(72deg)
            rotateZ(35deg)
            rotateZ(0);
    }

    to{
        transform:
            translate(-50%,-50%)
            rotateX(72deg)
            rotateZ(35deg)
            rotateZ(360deg);
    }
}

/* =========================================================
   SCROLL INDICATOR
========================================================= */

.scroll-indicator{
    position:absolute;

    bottom:30px;
    left:50%;

    transform:translateX(-50%);

    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    gap:9px;

    font-size:10px;
    letter-spacing:.22em;

    color:rgba(255,255,255,.7);

    z-index:5;
}

.scroll-line{
    width:1px;
    height:50px;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            to bottom,
            #fff,
            transparent
        );

    animation:scrollLine 2s ease-in-out infinite;
}

@keyframes scrollLine{
    0%,100%{
        transform:scaleY(.5);
        transform-origin:top;
    }

    50%{
        transform:scaleY(1);
    }
}

/* =========================================================
   INTRO
========================================================= */

.ibms-intro{
    padding:140px 8%;

    background:var(--cream);
    color:#111;

    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.5fr;
    gap:100px;

    align-items:center;
}

.section-number{
    font-size:14px;
    letter-spacing:.15em;
    color:#3e9c5f;
    font-weight:700;
}

.intro-title{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(40px,5vw,72px);
    line-height:1;

    letter-spacing:-.05em;

    margin-top:18px;
}

.intro-copy{
    max-width:700px;

    font-size:20px;
    line-height:1.7;

    color:#4b514d;
}

/* =========================================================
   FULL IMAGE
========================================================= */

.ibms-image{
    min-height:650px;

    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;

    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-end;

    padding:70px 8%;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            to top,
            rgba(0,0,0,.88),
            transparent 65%
        ),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497366811353-6870744d04b2?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2200&q=90");

    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
}

.image-caption{
    position:relative;
    z-index:2;
    max-width:760px;
}

.image-caption span{
    color:#70d995;
    font-size:13px;
    letter-spacing:.15em;
    font-weight:700;
}

.image-caption h2{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,72px);
    line-height:1;

    margin-top:15px;
    letter-spacing:-.04em;
}

/* =========================================================
   WHAT IBMS CONNECTS
========================================================= */

.integration{
    padding:140px 8%;
    background:#08110c;
}

.integration-header{
    max-width:850px;
    margin-bottom:90px;
}

.integration-header h2{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(45px,6vw,82px);
    line-height:.95;

    letter-spacing:-.05em;

    margin-top:18px;
}

.integration-header p{
    color:#9fa9a1;

    font-size:18px;
    line-height:1.7;

    margin-top:25px;

    max-width:700px;
}

.integration-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);

    border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    border-left:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
}

.integration-card{
    min-height:290px;

    padding:32px;

    border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);

    position:relative;

    overflow:hidden;

    transition:.4s ease;
}

.integration-card::before{
    content:"";

    position:absolute;

    width:180px;
    height:180px;

    right:-70px;
    bottom:-80px;

    border-radius:50%;

    background:rgba(66,206,116,.08);

    transition:.5s;
}

.integration-card:hover{
    background:rgba(65,190,106,.07);
    transform:translateY(-5px);
}

.integration-card:hover::before{
    transform:scale(1.7);
}

.integration-icon{
    width:50px;
    height:50px;

    border:1px solid rgba(105,230,145,.5);

    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    border-radius:50%;

    color:#72e99b;

    font-size:20px;

    margin-bottom:55px;

    box-shadow:0 0 25px rgba(62,201,111,.08);
}

.integration-card h3{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;
    font-size:28px;
    margin-bottom:12px;
}

.integration-card p{
    color:#929c95;
    font-size:14px;
    line-height:1.6;
    max-width:390px;
}

/* =========================================================
   CONTROL CENTER
========================================================= */

.control-center{
    padding:140px 8%;
    background:#f4f5ef;
    color:#111;
}

.control-head{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:flex-end;

    gap:50px;

    margin-bottom:70px;
}

.control-head h2{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(45px,6vw,80px);
    line-height:.95;

    letter-spacing:-.05em;
}

.control-head p{
    max-width:480px;

    color:#59615b;

    line-height:1.7;
}

.control-panel{
    min-height:510px;

    position:relative;

    overflow:hidden;

    background:#09130e;
    color:#fff;

    border-radius:4px;

    padding:35px;

    box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.14);
}

.panel-top{
    display:flex;
    justify-content:space-between;
    align-items:center;

    padding-bottom:22px;

    border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);

    font-size:12px;
}

.live{
    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    gap:8px;

    color:#75e99d;
    font-weight:700;
    letter-spacing:.08em;
}

.live-dot{
    width:7px;
    height:7px;
    background:#75e99d;
    border-radius:50%;
    box-shadow:0 0 12px #75e99d;

    animation:livePulse 1.5s infinite;
}

@keyframes livePulse{
    0%,100%{opacity:.35}
    50%{opacity:1}
}

.panel-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1.1fr 1fr .9fr;
    gap:18px;

    margin-top:20px;
}

.panel-card{
    min-height:185px;

    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            145deg,
            rgba(69,197,113,.09),
            rgba(255,255,255,.015)
        );

    padding:24px;
}

.panel-card small{
    color:#7e8982;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    letter-spacing:.1em;
    font-size:10px;
}

.panel-card strong{
    display:block;

    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:38px;

    margin-top:22px;

    color:#72e99b;
}

.status-bar{
    margin-top:18px;

    height:5px;

    background:#18231c;

    overflow:hidden;
}

.status-fill{
    height:100%;
    width:78%;

    background:#55d985;

    animation:statusFlow 4s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
}

@keyframes statusFlow{
    from{width:48%}
    to{width:91%}
}

.panel-chart{
    grid-column:1 / -1;

    height:205px;

    border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.09);

    margin-top:0;

    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,
            transparent 1px
        ),
        linear-gradient(
            90deg,
            rgba(255,255,255,.025) 1px,
            transparent 1px
        );

    background-size:50px 50px;
}

.panel-chart svg{
    width:100%;
    height:100%;
}

/* =========================================================
   BENEFITS
========================================================= */

.benefits{
    padding:140px 8%;
    background:#07100c;
}

.benefits-head{
    max-width:850px;
    margin-bottom:80px;
}

.benefits-head h2{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(45px,6vw,80px);
    line-height:.95;

    letter-spacing:-.05em;

    margin-top:18px;
}

.benefits-grid{
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);

    border-top:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
}

.benefit{
    min-height:300px;

    padding:35px 25px;

    border-right:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);

    position:relative;
}

.benefit:last-child{
    border-right:none;
}

.benefit-number{
    color:#70d995;

    font-size:12px;

    letter-spacing:.15em;

    font-weight:700;
}

.benefit h3{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:30px;

    margin:65px 0 18px;
}

.benefit p{
    color:#929d95;

    line-height:1.6;

    font-size:14px;
}

/* =========================================================
   FLOW
========================================================= */

.flow{
    padding:140px 8%;

    background:var(--cream);
    color:#111;
}

.flow-title{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(45px,6vw,82px);

    line-height:.95;

    letter-spacing:-.05em;

}

.flow-grid{
    display:grid;

.flow-item{

}

.flow-item span{
    color:#3d9d5e;

    font-size:12px;

    font-weight:700;

    letter-spacing:.12em;
}

.flow-item h3{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:27px;

    margin:42px 0 16px;
}

.flow-item p{
    color:#59605a;

    font-size:14px;

    line-height:1.6;
}

/* =========================================================
   PROJECT STRIP
========================================================= */

.project-strip{
    min-height:620px;

    padding:100px 8%;

    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-end;

    background:
        linear-gradient(
            to top,
            rgba(0,0,0,.9),
            rgba(0,0,0,.15)
        ),
        url("https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1497366754035-f200968a6e72?auto=format&fit=crop&w=2200&q=90");

    background-size:cover;
    background-position:center;
}

.project-content{
    max-width:800px;
}

.project-content h2{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(45px,6vw,82px);

    line-height:.95;

    letter-spacing:-.05em;

    margin-top:18px;
}

.project-content p{
    color:#d1d6d2;

    font-size:18px;

    line-height:1.7;

    max-width:650px;

    margin-top:25px;
}

/* =========================================================
   CTA
========================================================= */

.cta{
    min-height:500px;

    display:flex;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;

    text-align:center;

    padding:100px 8%;

    background:
        radial-gradient(
            circle at center,
            rgba(61,175,103,.22),
            transparent 40%
        ),
        #06100b;
}

.cta-inner{
    max-width:900px;
}

.cta h2{
    font-family:"Space Grotesk",sans-serif;

    font-size:clamp(48px,7vw,95px);

    line-height:.9;

    letter-spacing:-.06em;

    margin-top:18px;
}

.cta h2 span{
    color:#69d98f;
}

.cta p{
    color:#aeb8b1;

    font-size:18px;

    margin:30px auto;

    max-width:600px;

    line-height:1.6;
}

.cta-button{
    display:inline-flex;

<script>

/* =========================================================
   SCROLL REVEAL
========================================================= */

const revealElements =
    document.querySelectorAll(".reveal");

const revealObserver =
    new IntersectionObserver(
        (entries)=>{
            entries.forEach(entry=>{

                if(entry.isIntersecting){

                    entry.target.classList.add("active");

                    revealObserver.unobserve(
                        entry.target
                    );
                }

            });
        },
        {
            threshold:.12
        }
    );

revealElements.forEach(el=>{
    revealObserver.observe(el);
});


/* =========================================================
   HERO 3D MOUSE MOVEMENT
========================================================= */

const hero =
    document.querySelector(".ibms-hero");

const visual =
    document.querySelector(".ibms-visual");

hero.addEventListener("mousemove",(e)=>{

    const x =
        e.clientX / window.innerWidth - .5;

    const y =
        e.clientY / window.innerHeight - .5;

    visual.style.transform =
        `translateY(-50%)
         translate(${x*18}px,${y*18}px)`;
});


hero.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{

    visual.style.transform =
        "translateY(-50%)";

});


/* =========================================================
   IMAGE PARALLAX
========================================================= */

window.addEventListener("scroll",()=>{

    const section =
        document.querySelector(".ibms-image");

    if(!section) return;

    const rect =
        section.getBoundingClientRect();

    const offset =
        (window.innerHeight - rect.top) * .025;

    section.style.backgroundPosition =
        `center ${50-offset}%`;

});


/* =========================================================
   INTEGRATION CARD 3D TILT
========================================================= */

document
.querySelectorAll(".integration-card")
.forEach(card=>{

    card.addEventListener("mousemove",(e)=>{

        const rect =
            card.getBoundingClientRect();

        const x =
            e.clientX - rect.left;

        const y =
            e.clientY - rect.top;

        const rotateY =
            ((x / rect.width) - .5) * 5;

        const rotateX =
            ((y / rect.height) - .5) * -5;

        card.style.transform =
            `translateY(-5px)
             rotateX(${rotateX}deg)
             rotateY(${rotateY}deg)`;
    });


    card.addEventListener("mouseleave",()=>{

        card.style.transform =
            "translateY(0) rotateX(0) rotateY(0)";

    });

});


/* =========================================================
   PANEL LIVE DATA
========================================================= */

const liveValues = [
    {selector:".panel-card:nth-child(1) strong",values:["82%","84%","79%","87%"]},
    {selector:".panel-card:nth-child(2) strong",values:["64%","61%","68%","59%"]},
];

liveValues.forEach(item=>{

    const element =
        document.querySelector(item.selector);

    if(!element) return;

    let index = 0;

    setInterval(()=>{

        index =
            (index + 1) %
            item.values.length;

        element.textContent =
            item.values[index];

    },3000);

});

</script>
